publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With an increase in technology and the manufacturing of new items in the market can easily improve the quality of human lives. One of the important sectors is the automobile sector. With an increase in the population and usage of the vehicle has also increased in demands. With the increase in these sectors the vehicle theft cases and the number of accidents, rash driving cases are increasing by day-to-day life. Our paper deals with a solution for vehicle theft cases and a decrease in accident or rash driving cases. the main feature which makes it preferable is its low cost and can be implemented and used by many leading manufacturing companies. This system uses a GSM system, GPS, a buzzer, and a rash driving (mems) sensor for detecting rash driving. If anyone tries to start the vehicle without the permission of the owner, the vibration sensor will know the irregularity of the vehicle and send it to the microcontroller which will inform the owner via GSM and the buzzer will turn on. GPS tells us about the position like latitude, longitude, and height of an object. The mems sensor which is used in the system is used for finding the rash driving like if the vehicle falls then it will send to the owner that the vehicle might be fallen accidentally or met with an accident. Thus, this research work conclude that this system can be used in any vehicle like a car or bike and the system to intimate the owner about the theft of the vehicle and the owner can turn off the engine remotely by using a mobile phone.

articleTitle: Intelligence Embedded Image Caption Generator using LSTM based RNN Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Humans tend to extract information from everything they see be it living or non-living. This whole phenomenon motivated us to move in this direction and explore the field of computer vision and how this can be used with recurrent neural networks to generate captions from any image. By witnessing the recent increase in natural language processing-based applications; various other researchers have also worked on this concept and produced commendable results. Describing an image is not an easy task to implement, the structure and semantics of a sentence hold an important weight age in sentence formation. This paper approaches the problem of caption generation with an LSTM (Long-Short Term Memory) based RNN model and builds architecture based on the same to generate efficient and meaningful captions by training the dataset effectively. Flicker8k dataset is used to train our model and worked well. The accuracy of the model is evaluated based on standard evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Role of Exploratory Data Analysis in Data Science
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Exploratory Data analysis (EDA) is one of the hidden and mundane tasks in analysis of Data, as a Model, Project or analysis is based on data, which is intuitive, extremely heterogenous and distorted in its form. (Data has become an integral part of every project, Model &) The analyzed data is more insightful for identifying and improving extremely critical business insights across the Organization. This paper defines the exploratory data analysis phenomenon in detail and also states its role in the data analysis domain. Tools & Packages used in EDA are also discussed. In addition, the impact of missing out the phase of EDA in data analysis has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Diseased Leaf Segmentation from Complex Background Using Indices Based Histogram
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Early detection of plant diseases is a key to avoid losses in agriculture products' quality and quantity. The study of plant diseases entails the examination of visually discernible patterns on the plant. Plant health monitoring and disease identification are important for long-term agriculture. Manually monitoring plant diseases is extremely difficult that requires a great deal of effort, knowledge of plant diseases, and an inordinate amount of time consumed. As a result, image processing methods are employed to identify plant diseases. In the disease detection process, various phases of digital image processing are incorporated. The proposed work adapted a different kind of segmentation for getting the plant disease attributes based on the leaves images. The dataset used is collected from Plant Village, Kaggle, and Mendeley datasets with different plant leave images that include different shape, margin, and texture features for identifying the disease attacked to it. The collected dataset is sliced with train and test data classifiers and processed. Segmentation performance by an indices-based histogram approach resulted in 92.06% accuracy.

articleTitle: WebSecAsst - A Machine Learning based Chrome Extension
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A browser extension, also known as a plugin or an addon, is a small software application that adds functionality to a web browser. However, security threats are always linked with such software where data can be compromised and ultimately trust is broken. The proposed research work jas developed a security model named WebSecAsst, which is a chrome plugin relying on the Machine Learning model XGBoost and VirusTotal to detect malicious websites visited by the user and to detect whether the files downloaded from the internet are Malicious or Safe. During this detection, the proposed model preserves the privacy of the user's data to a greater extent than the existing commercial chrome extensions.

articleTitle: IoT based Safety System for Women
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In today's world, women's safety is a common concern, and it is everyone's duty to address it. This paper describes a “GPS and GSM Circuit based lady's security framework with an alarm and a shock generating device,” as well as a “GPS and GSM Circuit based ladies security framework with an alarm and a shock generating system.” This offers a collection of GPS devices that are primarily used to monitor the location [1]. Aside from that, the device will send out warnings, electric shocks, and crisis capture triggers. The main goal of this paper is to show a device that is so conservative that it provides a desirable disguised role. The main feature of this platform is that it does not include the use of a smart phone, which sets it apart from other applications currently available. The device is easy to use and blends in with the proposed apparatus. The device is resistant to all weather conditions and can examine any possibility of assisting the trick in every kind of emergency [3].

articleTitle: Accident Alert and Ambulance Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A mobile tracking application for emergency ambulance services is proposed in this paper with various challenges in vehicle tracking and monitoring system. The system issues alert messages in case of emergency. The alert system is essential to provide information about the location of the accident or driver's location. In the conventional method, the ambulance driver could not reach the accident location on time due to heavy traffic, leading to loss of many lives. With the current technological advancements in smartphones and mobile apps, a mobile app for tracking ambulance in real time is proposed in this paper. This application will let the ambulance driver record its availability and location. The user who executes the emergency will book the ambulance and log in to the user. The user location and nearby ambulances will be precisely pointed out on the Google map. Once the patient is boarded, the location of the ambulance will be recorded and sent to the traffic police present at the traffic signal. The driver then selects the nearby hospital on the map, which helps to treat the patients on time. The location of ambulance is tracked by the navigator based on Web Services. This technology will help the ambulance location to be updated in the database. In addition, the traffic signal can be controlled based on the upcoming ambulance vehicle thus providing a traffic less route.

articleTitle: Reversible 2:4 Decoder Using Universal Fredkin Gate
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The technologies like quantum computing, Nanotechnology is emerging due to the greater research in reversible logic. It has the power reduction capability the same mechanism is also having in the quantum computing. Designing a quantum circuit among various combinational circuits the decoder has capability to change binary information of input lines to distinct output lines and also there are many applications where decoder is the main basic component. In this paper a comprehensive introduction of basic gates used to design n to 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> Universal Quantum decoder, here n represents the no of inputs are mentioned. The proposed 2:4 decoder circuit is designed using a universal reversible Fredkin gates and Feynman gate. The proposed work is simulated using IBM Quantum Composer. In comparison to existing quantum decoders the proposed decoder design has optimum values in all the parameters considered.

articleTitle: Helmet Detection Using YOLO V3 And Single Shot Detector
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Wearing a Safety helmet is vital to the well-being of labourers at building destinations and production lines. Instructions to caution or recognize labourers regardless of whether the protective helmet is worn, is regularly a troublesome point for undertakings to screen. This project presents a mechanized system to recognize motor bikers without a helmet and labourers without wearing the helmet. On the helmet identification conundrum, a You Only Look Once (YOLO) model is used. This model will only consider the bounding box territories of construction labourers and motorcyclists using a single structure. Further applying the Single-shot detector (SSD) model to upgrade the prepared pictures likewise perform better in picture limitation because of successful component combination, which is more under the prerequisite of acknowledgement of helmet. The basis of this model is highly critical in terms of enhancing helmet recognition and ensuring secure estimation.

articleTitle: Review of Pulse Modulation Controllers for reduced swiches Multil-level converters
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This work is about the review of various pulse width modulation (PWM) controller techniques and newer Multi Level inverter topologies. As the renewable sources generates power at lower voltage level and in the form of DC, always a need of conversion devices like DC and AC converters. The high-power electronic converters are those can convert the available energy to form of energy required by the grid or load. These converters usually operate at very higher frequencies as like electronic circuits, but the difference is operating power. Generally electronic circuits will operate at lower power levels, but the converters used in the power conversion have to operate at higher power level. So, the controlling mechanism for these converters play a key role in the performance of a converter, in this paper some of the PWM methods has been stated with their characteristics and also a hybrid MLI with the new topologies has been compared.

articleTitle: Retracted: Helmet Detection using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The continuous mobilization of vehicles has led to a surge in the number of road accidents across the world. To get better of this, government is trying to focus on the safest and preventive measures in traffic. So, our main idea is to introduce a helmet detection mechanism as most of the deaths caused are due to the absence of helmet. The practice of direct observation is found to be time taking and a lot of human effort is needed. This project attempts to implement a detection process through a few machine learning algorithms by using pre-defined libraries. This system notices a person with/without a helmet thereby imposing fines on the detected candidates. Further, this research work concludes that the automatic identification of helmets can overcome the challenges faced by manual data collection process. Moreover, this research work assumed that, through data collection, the algorithm can help to track the helmet use and promote its active use by people in order to ensure the road safety

articleTitle: Strong Authentication and Encryption Modeling using Physical Unclonable Function based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: It is an important factor to verify the authenticity of an electronic device so as to confirm the strength and protection of electronic network which provides user the secured access and control of network and allowing for identification and verification of hardware devices. In this study, we reviewed the research done so far by taking a brief look at PUF and comparing how PUF was implemented in software and hardware. This paper also describes the types of PUF and reviews the challenges in PUF.

articleTitle: IoT and LORA Based Substation Monitoring and Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Methods for monitoring temperature, current, voltage and oil level are proposed in this framework. It uses Arduino to read temperature, current, voltage and oil level from sensors in a single-phase power system. The calculated information is then submitted to the IoT application and the LoRa handling system. When a mistake happens, the burden is turned off and then turned back on until it has been rectified. The LoRa handling machine is employed. The IoT module is used by the IoT server to monitor these values.

articleTitle: The Prediction of Quality of the Air Using Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In general, Pollution of the climate refers to the discharge of pollutants into the atmosphere that damage human health and the environment as a whole. It has the ability to be one of the most dangerous things humans have ever experienced. It damages livestock, crops, and forests, among other things. To avoid this issue in mostly urban areas, the popular approach such as machine learning techniques may be used to predict air quality from contaminants. As a consequence, the quality of the air assessment and forecasting has become an important field of study. The goal is to develop machine learning-based air quality forecasting techniques that are as accurate as possible. The supervised machine learning technique (SMLT) will be used to gather several pieces of information from the dataset, including variable recognition, uni-variate analysis, bi-variate and multi-variate analysis, missing value treatment and analysis, data cleaning/preparation, and data representation. Our findings provide a valuable guide to sensitivity analysis of model parameters in terms of success in air quality pollution prediction through accuracy measurement. By comparing supervise classification machine learning algorithms and generating prediction results in the form of best accuracy, create a machine learning-based method for accurately predicting the Air Quality Index value. Furthermore, to compare and discuss various machine learning algorithms in order to determine the most accurate algorithm with the performance of a GUI-based user interface for air quality prediction. Motivation: The aim is to create a machine learning model for realtime air quality forecasting that can potentially replace updatable supervised machine learning classification models by predicting best accuracy by comparing supervised algorithms. The aim of this project is to use machine learning to investigate a dataset of air pollutants records for the Indian meteorological sector. It is more difficult to determine air quality. This research work attempts to reduce the risk factor associated with forecasting the Air Quality Index (AQI) of India to a safe human level in order to save a significant amount of meteorological time and resources, as well as to predict whether the air quality is bad or good.

articleTitle: Analysis on agronomy and recent detection methods of rhizome rot in turmeric and methodology using artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Agriculture is the backbone of many countries. Turmeric is one such crop which is famously cultivated in different areas of the globe. The crop harvest is mostly diminished by the disease affecting the plant. The major infection influence the plant are leaf blotch, leaf spot and rhizome rot. Among the reported diseases, rhizome rot is a dangerous and highly destructive disease in turmeric production which leads to more than 60% crop loss. Pythium is the foremost species in rhizome rot occurrence. Farmers are unable to see or predict this diseases at an early stage because the disease directly affects the rhizome which is present in underground. So we propose a method which detects the pythium occurrence at an early stage and report it to the farmers. This paper covers turmeric geographical distribution, agronomy, major, minor diseases and disease control measures.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Powered Smart Dumpster Monitoring and Clearance System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: According to the Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy, India is one of the well resourced countries with plenty of raw materials. Since the raw materials are easily available, the human requirement also increases which leads to mass production of waste. Waste materials thus produced can be reverted into resources by recycling process. This recycling process can be done by proper sorting of waste into various categories like degradable and non-degradable wastes by human efforts. Recycling contamination also occurs when harmful wastes are mixed together. This paper comes up with an idea of smart dumpster monitoring and clearance system which sorts the garbage using Machine Learning based image classification. After sorting and disposal of waste, it notifies the municipality waste collector through Wi-Fi module over the internet about the bin level for collection of garbage before the bin overflows.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring of three phase induction motor using infrared thermography
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the current industrial scenario, three phase induction motors are mainly utilized as prime movers. Their collapse not only impact procedure downtime however additionally leads to manufacturing loss. On that account, its health monitoring is necessary as it expands its accessibility and efficiency. Infrared Thermal camera is a standard heat signature demonstrating instrument. As of up-to-date setting, infrared imaging is now fully grown and very popular technique for condition monitoring, using this temperature assessment are often directed progressively in non-contact way. Infrared diagnostic technique is employed as a method to differentiate variation from conventional range of temperature, small fluctuations within induction motor are applicable, however any uncommon change in temperature should be perceived, which can be an indication of excessive thermal stress and should be dealt with on time. Generally high temperatures harm the insulation of induction motor and in this way lessen its life expectancy. This paper traces a way to deal with detection of hotspot, thermal efficiency, remaining life and impact of temperature rise with time on induction motor which would help industries for predicting maintenance, preventing failures of induction motors.

articleTitle: Multiband Printed Planar Inverted-F Antenna(PIFA)For LTE Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The demands of a multiband antenna in the era of modern communication for longer connectivity, high data rate, low latency, and much more features the LTE band is developing. The designer can also consider the miniaturization of the antenna so that a large integrated circuit will be developed for various applications in smartphones. In this paper, a multiband printed Planar Inverted-F Antenna (PIFA) is designed on the FR4 (ϵr=4.4) substrate. Our proposed antenna covers the multiple bands of LTE which are 1700MHz, 2300MHz, and 3500MHz with a reflection coefficient of -31.50dB, -30dB, and -32.50dB respectively. By putting multiple slots in the ground element and by applying parasitic element with PIFA design. The performance of the antenna can be easily improved and the observed gain is 3dBi at 1700MHz, 3dBi at 2300MHz, and 2.5dBi at 3500MHz. The proposed research work has designed and simulated the antenna on CAD-FEKO software.

articleTitle: A Compact & Low Power Architecture of XXTEA192 Lightweight block cipher
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: RFID and IoT security threats have been increased due to the enormous usage of ubiquitous computing devices. Providing security to RFID tags is one of perplexing tasks as it has to meet rigid area and power requirements. This paper has proposed a compact serial architecture for XXTEA-192 block cipher which can be used in RFID applications. The RFID tags are constrained with limited area and power. XXTEA is the most secured version among the ciphers of TEA family. This cipher works on variable length message with a minimum message length of 62-bit and should be a multiple of 32-bit words. This feature enables the cipher to encrypt larger block sizes. Serial architecture of XXTEA-192 has been proposed that performs 32-bit operations like addition, XOR and shifting in each clock cycle. The proposed design has been implemented using verilog. Analysis of performance metrics like area, throughput, efficiency, power and energy has been performed on different families of FPGA devices like Spartan 6, Virtex 6 and Virtex 7. The proposed design has achieved 45 slices and a throughput of 498.44 Mbps on Spartan 6 making the architecture area and speed efficient for RFID applications.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of Emotion Classification on Textual Data
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Emotion analysis plays a part in understanding the feelings of human beings. People's actions and speech express various feelings, behaviors and emotions which can have various impacts. Emotion and sentiment analysis is a broad research area for finding emotion which helps getting useful insight through text and speech. In most of previous work, nearly all projects have focused on analyzing the expression based on positive, negative and neutral classification. This research work analyzes the proposed system by categorizing the text into emotion classes called joy, sadness, anger, fear, love and surprise. This work helps us to label text emotions into multiple classes and categorize the text for better accuracy. This research work represents the enhancement of a novel Deep Learning model scheme, Long Short-Term Memory and Recurrent Neural Network which discuss various categories distribution on knowledgeable data. This will also summarize the previous works done on textual emotional classification based on various sentiment models and approach with comparative survey analysis.

articleTitle: Circuit Reliability Through Probabilistic Transfer Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Circuit reliability is a growing concern in today's CMOS electronics, over the years, this has sparked a great deal of interest in reliability-oriented circuit design and reliability analysis. While several approaches to circuit reliability analysis have been published, comparative studies on their benefits and drawbacks in terms of efficiency and accuracy are lacking. This paper offers an overview of the probabilistic transfer matrix approach for reliability analysis, with an emphasis on large and small, gate-level circuits, transistor-level logic gates under stuck-on faults, and transistor failure probability through reliability analysis.

articleTitle: K-Means and Competitive Neural Network Based Clustering of Climate Data
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The city Nainital is a beautiful hill station of Uttarakhand, India. The summers of this city is very pleasant, as compared to other places, due to its very favorable climatic conditions. The climatic secondary data of Nainital is the plot of this research work. This data is comprised of 90 samples containing the values of minimum temperature, maximum temperature and rainfall for three seasons, namely summer, winter and rainy. The aim of this work is to design clustering models, on basis of this data, for the exact classification of inputs into three classes (i.e. summer, winter and rainy). The two different clustering techniques, adopted in this work, using MATLAB, are K-means clustering and the neural network based competitive learning approach. Finally, the clustering performance of both the techniques is compared.

articleTitle: IOT enabled Smart home and health monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The health of the patients within the hospital is severely affected if they're not treated properly on time and there's a high risk of inflicting a lot of diseases. Patient's observance could be a difficult think about the past years. Thence there's a requirement for an answer to watch the patients anytime for the doctors from anyplace. With event of web of Things (IoT) devices within the recent years an answer is projected for this. as a contraption. Health has prime importance in our day-after-This work will be useful for researchers and practitioners in the field, helping them to understand the huge potential of IoT in medical domain and identification of major challenges in IOT. Sound health is important to try to the daily work properly. This project aims at developing a sensor that is used to track the patient's heartbeat lively with the help of smart phones using IOT technology. In this paper, a portable framework is displayed which constantly check patient's heartbeat, temperature and some parameters of the room with the help of Wi-Fi module. A IOT enabled smart home and health monitoring system is proposed where the authorized personal data can be accessed using any IOT platform and based on the output values received, the exact disease is diagnosed by a doctor even at far distance.

articleTitle: Road Accident Analysis and Hotspot Prediction using Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Road accidents are a major cause of fatalities in India and other nations too. Fatality rate in developing nations is very high due to various aspects. In the past, it was assumed that road accidents and fatalities cannot be avoided, but now with this tech era, everything is almost becoming possible. Machine learning (ML) is used to analyze various algorithms through experience and improve results. It includes three major types of learning techniques, namely supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning. Our study focuses on reducing mortality rate by setting up a prediction model by means of an unsupervised learning technique, i.e., k-means clustering, which analyzes road accidents by taking into consideration various aspects like potholes on roads, sharp turns, and weather conditions and then provides suitable and precautionary measures to avoid mishaps by representing it on map and creating an intelligible model for everyone. The predicted model achieved an accuracy of 81%.

articleTitle: POSTGRESQL based monitoring and controlling the parameters for patients
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Generally, due to pandemic it is extremely difficult to consult with doctors and nurses. The availability of physicians at hospitals is extremely challenging; this is not a concern for patients; rather, the needs of patients must be monitored. In the event of illness monitoring, it is necessary to regulate and provide medications in accordance with the regular consult. In the suggested work, a web application must be developed. The developed web application is used to find the symptoms and the need to express their symptoms and difficult issues. Web applications process their symptoms issues and check their symptoms that have the values given to user. It also checks the temperature rate and heartbeat rate in real time by using the hardware implementation in Arduino and checks whether it is normal. It will provide a facility for all the patients to get appointment through this site. The doctor interface is planned to develop thereby it will maintain which doctor is available and which doctor not. It will reveal all the personal information of physicians, such as their addresses, phone numbers, specializations, and qualifications. All parametric values are read and it feedback the values with high accuracy to everyone, and the values are error-free, with a focus on accuracy. The values and parametric reading will be sent to patients for their satisfaction.

articleTitle: Techniques for Multi-Omics Data Incorporating Machine Learning and System Genomics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The constantly growing demand to inaugurate algorithm in genomics system and machine learning in conjunction with multi-omic data for measuring possible genotype-phenotype connections has become immensely favourable in big data science, biomedical computing as well as in precision medicine in recent years. MLSG comprise computer code systems that are utilized to investigate several thousand multi-omics details by high-level scientific research. To examine and incorporate Multi-omics results, this research work inspects MLSG code systems and potential headings. Our research is mainly centered on investigating subsequent methods and advanced structures for MLSG multi-omics program schemes.

articleTitle: A Cost-Effective Smart Walking Stick for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, a smart stick guidance model for visually disabled citizens has been presented. An Arduino-based controlling system, an Ultrasonic sensor for detecting objects around the user to prevent lethal injuries, a Light sensor module to monitor the strength of the light in the surroundings, LED lights to send the signal to the surroundings, DC power system to operate the controlling module, and a buzzer to detect obstacles around the stick are all included in this package. According to our study, most visually assistive systems are intended for users. However, our proposed system is not only for assisting visually disabled user but also for directing people navigating around them in order to prevent unintended injuries.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Ophthalmic Diseases in Fundus Image Using various Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Many ophthalmic diseases occur due to damage in the retina, optic disc, and macula of the eye. This can cause permanent vision loss or blindness. Ophthalmology has begun to work extensively on identifying eye diseases in morphological datasets using image-based diagnostic techniques. A conventional technique fails to predict these disease categories because this technique is time-consuming and required clinical experts to predict them. This review surveys the different methods used for the detection of ophthalmic diseases such as cataracts, age-related macular degeneration, hypertensive retinopathy, myopia, etc.

articleTitle: IOT Based Agriculture Monitoring and Controlling System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper provides us with a method to check the moisture level and water quality of the soil with use of IOT. In India, the main economic structure is based on the agriculture sector. Worldwide, India is in second position regarding farm output. Agriculture is done in every country from our ascents period. Agriculture is the art of cultivating plants. As known already, agriculture is considered as the key development in human civilization. For trending in agriculture IOT plays important role in smart agriculture. Now let me explain how this works IOT sensors are helpful in providing information about agriculture fields. Using the IOT based agriculture monitoring system helps us in collecting data from the wireless sensors networks and s this information sends through the wireless protocol. When the system is implemented then it will receive the data from the three different sensors and this data will be send to the mobile phone and it will alert the user through the IoT. This data will be displayed in bylink interface where you will see the data about the temperature and soil moisture level, Humidity, water quality. Temperature is often a specific level; it's supported the sort crops cultivated. If it is intended to forcefully shut down (stop) the water with the help of the proposed IoT model, there will be a button given from where the pump is often forcefully stopped. The information can be accessed by the farmers with the use of smart devices.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of Various Techniques for Hostile Drone Detection and Their Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Today's atmosphere is being increasingly congested due to the proliferation of airborne objects such as small airplanes, helicopters, and unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) of varying forms and sizes. The UAVs can also become a major threat as they can be utilized in smuggling, industrial spy, robbery, and terrorism, besides enabling access to new technologies. Owing to its speed, agility, and altitude, it is hard to defend against a UAV incursion. Aerial defence systems are integrated with a wide range of sensors to efficiently track aircraft. There are several methods and techniques discussed in this paper that are ideal for this specific application. This paper also discusses the paradigm of drone detection using Radar and Imaging techniques and the classification of drones based on their size, features, flying height, and Unique Identification Number (UIN).

articleTitle: Internet of Things and Wireless Sensor Network Solution in Smart Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The prevailing quality, sustainability, smartening, and usability in the world are the key challenges of today's advanced technological revolution. Through innovation and development, the Internet of Things has connected artefacts and provided the world with exemplary authenticity. Because of the convergence of multi-technologies, machine learning, embedded systems, real-time analytics, and commodity sensors, Internet of Things technology is synonymous with the concept of an “Intelligent Environment”. Wireless computer networks are some disseminated or resolution sensors that observe corporeal or environmental states; to acclaim temperature, sound, moisture, pressure, and so on; and to hand in glove transmit their information through the network to the most remote site. This article discusses about the philosophy used for smartening environmental observance with the implementation of various wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Transparent Solar Panel using Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Energy is one of our most fundamental necessities, as every appliance we use in our daily lives need power. Moreover, the Solar energy is remaining as a key component of renewable energy sources. Solar energy is one of the most ubiquitous sources of energy, which is why many new technologies are being developed to harness the energy from the sun and convert it to electricity. The energy required for smart irrigation can be supplied by using electrical energy and the amount of power generated is also directly proportionate to the amount of land occupied. The most common usage of transparent solar panels will be in tech parks and some buildings. However, if we use this technology in farm fields, it will assist to produce 100% of efficient energy and completely eliminate pollution. Also, one of the greatest advantages of using transparent solar panels in a farm fieldis to increase the productivity of crops by making it as a roof and preventing the crops from heavy rainfall, flood, locust attacks (insect attacks) and also it makes a place for the storage of grains, and establish much profits in implementing it in a farm field. It's highly useful for farmers by using IOT for monitoring, collecting, and then storing the information in the cloud for future use.

articleTitle: Identification of Timber Defects Using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Timber is important in the construction industry. Random checking in the manufacturing line, randomized product selection, and condition monitoring are some of the most common quality control methods for wood panels. Manufacturing can continue if the checked products' expectations are met; however, if flaws or anomalies are discovered, the supply chain is shut down, a remedy sought, and the manufacturer loses productivity. Skilled human operators continue to perform the bulk of visual quality inspections in the timber products industrial processes. Visual inspection is a time-consuming and labor-intensive process that is prone to human error. New automation processes based on high-resolution images and inspection systems are currently being developed, but these are yet quick or not accurate enough for real-time industrial processes. Using an automated visual inspection device, the whole project proposes a method for recognizing and classifying defects on the surface of wood. Here, a convolution neural network has been used to detect the defects present on wooden surface layers.

articleTitle: ASIC Design of a 32-bit Low Power RISC-V based System Core for Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The electronic devices play a decisive role in the realm of medical applications. The analysis of medical images and axial tomography scanners are uses high performance processors. There is plenty of micro-controller intellectual property (IP) available for the development of ASICs, however these are tied to restrictive, expensive licenses and typically not reliable and open for customization. The reliability being a primary concern the RISC-V core aiming to development of a scalable open instruction set architecture (ISA) for medical applications. In this paper designed and implemented the 32-bit low power RISC-V based system core from RTL to GDSII. The functional verification of 32-bit five stage RISC- V system core is caried out in NC Launch tool and generated the gate level netlist using 180nm technology library file in the Genus tool. The static timing analysis is caried out for setup and hold timing analysis in the Cadence Tempus Timing Signoff tool. The floor planning, placement and routing of 32-bit RISC- V processor is implemented on Innovus tool. The area, power and timing reports are generated at each stage in the physical design. After carrying out pre-clock tree synthesis, post clock tree synthesis and post routing of circuit, obtained the optimized results for arrival timing 9.868ps, power is 3.793mW and area is 72409.1 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Virtual Banking Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper is to present a cashless payment system that is mainly based on the fingerprint. The main motto of the project is to complete a transaction without using debit cards or cash. Because nowadays many unauthorized transactions are taking place due to this, anyone can drain the money in your account. Many banks are also trying to keep the security at a higher level. To accomplish a higher security, this research work uses a fingerprint technology, which can be different for every citizen. Finger print device is more flexible to use, and it is a low-cost device and reliable. By this device, a user can have a chance not to carry any cards or cash for any payments. Many are frustrated by remembering many passwords. The proposed research work can eradicate the problem with this device. Using this technology, the number of fraud transactions can be reduced. The user can get an alert whenever a transaction has been done whether it is successful or not. If any person enters the wrong password for more than three times, the image of the particular person who is performing the particular transaction will be captured and an email consisting of that captured photo will be sent to the registered mail. This device also consists of the speaker, which will be intimate on the successful completion of the transaction.

articleTitle: A Levenshtein distance based implementation of lost character prediction, imputation and tagging in Malayalam palm leaf bundles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Character prediction, which predicts the next probable character given a character or a sequence of characters, is one of the significant tasks coming under Natural Language Processing. The application of these tasks is most relevant in predicting characters written in old documents that might get lost due to aging, insect bites, fungus, etc. From the starting stage of NLP research, numerous frameworks were proposed for various dialects prediction tasks. There has been a significant progress in this field in many languages but not in the Malayalam language. Due to lot many reasons, a lot of missing content that makes these repositories not suitable for exploitation. So in this paper, a Levenshtein distance based model, which is independent of the grammatical structure of the language, is developed, for lost character prediction and tagging in old Malayalam palm leaf manuscripts bundles. The model is able to give an accuracy of 81.02% for the palm leaf manuscript bundles considered for the experiment.

articleTitle: Area and Energy Efficient QCA based Decoder
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Quantum Dot Cellular Automata (QCA) is a layout level tool used for designing digital logic circuits at nano scale. It can be regarded as the substitute for CMOS technology in nano-scale. Designing decoders in nano scale (QCA) provides advantages such as effective area utilization, energy dissipation and cost. The aim of the paper isto minimize the number of cells, area, cost and the cost energy dissipation in decoders. This paper presents a cost effective and compact design for QCA based 2 to 4 and 3 to 8 decoders. The paper proposes a design for the decoders in a multi-cell layer structure with appropriate energy dissipation analysis. The proposed 2 to 4 decodercircuit has achieved an overall improvement of 29.57% in terms of cell count and an improvement of 68.8% in cost function compared to reference circuit. The proposed 3 to 8 decoder circuit has a reduction of 53.8% in total cell count and 59.25% in terms of cost function w.r.t the earlier proposed circuits. The energy analysis is performed by QCADesigner-E tool and the circuit isrealized in QCADesigner 2.0.3 CAD tool. The proposed decoder is pre-eminence compared to reference decoder in terms of cost, cell count, area andenergy dissipation.

articleTitle: MESH ENABLED IOT BASED SMART DEVICE FOR ATHLETES
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Athletes are persons who are skilled in sports and other exercises. They take part in field tracks and competitive events. Athletes compete in various parameters like speed, physical strength, Positioning, etc. Every athlete must stay fit and healthy. Constant monitoring is done through this device. Consistent health status and progress in Game is essential. This device provides real-time data of the player like acceleration, angle, directions, and their health status during games and training. It also helps the audience understand the game better and to learn the performance of the player. This device can support both Wi-Fi and Bluetooth mesh networks. This project deals with real-time data of a game collected from various devices, sent and stored in the cloud, and can be accessed from anywhere anytime. Through this device, Trainees can be able to track their player's status every day so that they need not be with the player all day. Particle argon is used to mesh Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

articleTitle: Design of Multiple Online Interactive Guiding Platform for College English in the Information Technology Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the wide application of information technology and the popularization of computer and other electronic equipment, networked learning has swept the world. Educational informationization has become the inevitable requirement and trend of educational reform and development in the information age. The priority among priorities of educational informatization is to use modern and advanced information technology means. Therefore, it is necessary to reform the teaching mode and improve the quality of teaching. Blended learning is not only a mixture of online learning and offline classroom learning, but also a mixture of various learning environments, learning styles and learning theories. In short, it is the product of the contemporary educational informationization concept put into practice. This mode is the inevitable trend to promote the steady development of China's educational reform vision.

articleTitle: Wildlife surveillance using deep learning with YOLOv3 model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Identifying an animal is not so easy task because there are many different types of animals which look alike and classifying each animal is difficult. Which made us to create a model called YOLOv3. When the user is in need to find an animal, this YOLOv3 model helps that user to find the respective animal's name in an easy manner by just looking at the picture that the user has given. This research work has used the darknet algorithm, which has a pretrained dataset in YOLOv3 model. The model itself works on various ways by training and testing of a picture in the dataset. The goal is to use the YOLOv3 model in finding the animal in a smipler method. First, the input image of an animal is given and on the input image itself it gives the output as in, the name of the animal using this YOLOv3 model. The present study discusses about the state of species-specific activitiy by using the form of still image.

articleTitle: Work-in-Progress: Development of a Stress Based End-to-End Flow Silicon Validation Framework for an Advanced Ethernet Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: There is a constant demand for semiconductor chips which are getting miniaturized due to advances in VLSI design. This helps in modularizing ethernet controller-based System on Chips into smaller compact setups. It is seen that most of the designs are now being implemented in 7nm and even 5nm technologies, hence the complexity of these devices also increases. There exists certain restrictions and constraints with regards to reusability of tests and there are limitations with respect to making the test content platform independent. Also, there are constraints with regards to the test coverage, i.e. inability to cover all possible scenarios in silicon validation. Exiting validation frameworks are usually present as independent feature wise tests rather than emphasizing on the end-to-end flow from host interface to the customer network. Hence, it's highly imperative that all validation procedures are executed both in the base blocks, feature wise, and develop system level tests. This would help detect and fix bugs that may exist in the overall integrated system, which usually could be missed by traditional frameworks. Pre-silicon validation is an essential component that precedes tape in and post silicon validation and is generally performed feature wise individually along with basic integration tests. Hence, the prime objective of this study is to develop a validation framework comprising of tests which can validate the IP functionalities of the advanced ethernet controller. The next stage of the project is to develop an efficient consolidated end-to-end basic test coverage which incorporates all the functionalities and verify and regress the consolidated test coverage developed, which forms the basis for future scope of this work. The intermediate test results have shown successful implementation of the feature-based tests for reset, control queues and virtualization. Packet drops are evaluated for each of the features and is seen to occur at a rate of 52% on an average for the tests.

articleTitle: VR Interactive Game System Based on Unity3d and Flow Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: VR interactive game system based on Unity3d and flow data processing is designed and implemented in this paper. Augmented reality technology is a technology that is upgraded on the basis of virtual reality technology. Through this technology, scenes in the real world can be perfectly integrated into the virtual world, so that the two scenes can complement each other, for the better implementation, the Unity3d should be combined. As the innovative aspect, this paper proposes the interactive mode with the analysis of the flow data. The data mining section is optimized with the complex data structure. The system is implemented and tested on the collected data. It is reflected from the results that the proposed framework is efficient.

articleTitle: Design of a GPS Enabled Maximum Power Point Solar Tracker for Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Due to the large power potential of solar energy and the high cost of power generation by conventional sources, people are now shifting towards solar energy. Electricity generation from solar power is not a new concept, but earlier due to the lack of proper technology the capital cost involved in electricity generation was very high. But now, the advancement in technology and the use of new techniques have reduced the generation cost. This paper discusses about obe such technique called maximum power point tracking (MPPT). It was a revolutionary concept that helped in reducing one of the limitations of solar power, i.e. irregularities in power output. Here, this research work discusses about the available different types of MPPT methods, their advantages, and limitations and then a new design of solar tracker will be proposed to generate more power on a moving platform. Also, the proposed research work will discuss its challenges and advantages in detail and also about its different components. A detailed design of the proposed system has also been provided.

articleTitle: Bangladesh Metropolitan Crime Area Prediction Using Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Today's world faces many problems with crime, affecting the day to day livings and bringing general socio-economic progress to a standstill.. Different types of crimes happen daily and nightly. If it cannot be carefully noticed or managed, it would be a great disaster for any country. Therefore, this paper was aimed at predicting metropolitan Bangladesh at different crime rates in different times. In this paper, different types of machine learning techniques could be used, but Decision Tree was used based on crime quantity to forecast Bangladesh's metropolitan area and finally analyze the result depending on the algorithm's result. In this paper we focused on Metropolitan Police Aare like DMP, CMP, KMP, RMP, BMP, SMP, Railway where D means Dhaka, C means Chittagong, K means Khulna, R means Rajshahi, B means Barisal, S means Sylhet, and MP means Metropolitan Police.

articleTitle: Designing of Serial Asynchronous to Analog Resolver Format Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This article presents the design of an interface solution for two systems where the input system gives angular information in serial asynchronous format while the end system requires it in Analog Resolver format. The angular information examined here was the ship's Roll and Pitch as obtained from the ship's RLG (Ring Laser Gyro) equipment. The OrCAD cadence proprietary software tool package was used to create an embedded board. The proposed model is developed by using microcontroller 8051, Digital to Resolver converter module and some other required components, and further it was tested by using simulated Roll Pitch angular information, which is generated with the help of COM Port Toolkit and the output of this interface solution was measured on API (Angle Position Indicator) and Oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Application of Relay in Low Voltage Apparatus of Electrical Engineering Automation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Rapid advancement of the science has required the emerging development of electrical systems. Inspired by this, the paper studies the application of relay in low voltage apparatus of electrical engineering automation. The application of automated low-voltage electrical appliances that greatly enhances the convenience of people's production and life. In automated low-voltage electrical appliances, the application of the relays can effectively improve the electrical convenience, provide high-quality electrical services for people's production and life, and meet people's actual needs. To further study the model, this paper proposes the application scenario of automation. The data analytic model is designed for the comprehensive analysis of the performance. The experimental results have proven that the proposed model is efficient.

articleTitle: Public Opinion Prediction based on Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet in our country, the information on the Internet has spread rapidly like an explosion. The convenience of the Internet shortens the time it takes for people to exchange information, which is likely to cause the outbreak of hot-spot incidents of online public opinion. The public opinion orientation on the Internet will directly affect the real thoughts and behaviors of offline people. In order to avoid the occurrence of major influential public opinion events, timely grasping the hot topics discussed by people, and paying attention and positive guidance are important means of maintaining social harmony and stability. Markov logic network is a first-order logic knowledge base with additional weights for formulas. From the perspective of probability theory, Markov logic network provides a concise description language for Markov network, and can flexibly introduce a large amount of domain knowledge into Markov network. Therefore, this article studies the prediction model of public policy public opinion based on Markov model.

articleTitle: Student Performance Appraisal System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the past few years, various appraisal systems have been analyzed and studied in order to keep track of educational activities. This paper enlightens the evaluation scheme of student's performance by using a machine learning algorithm that helps us to achieve better results when a large number of data is to be handled and managed for the storage of student's data. Filtration is going to be done over the analysis system on the idea of grades or the marks of the students. Our aim is to design a system of records with user-friendly Graphical user interface which can assists student in addition to the evaluation of their performance. Although in recent days various institutions have been come up with their own appraisal systems with machine learning and advanced data analytics techniques, there are some issues regarding data and results of the students of previous years. This paper attempts to introduce such a system, which will not only work for performance appraisal but also tries to avoid network congestion and unnecessary traffic over a wireless network. K-means clustering provides versatility in filtering the student's records based on their grades will be a big factor to handle and recollect the data load from the Cassandra database which acts as a storage house of our current proposed system. Nonetheless, results which are defined as an outcome of this project are more accurate and easier to understand.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Automation Technology in Automobile Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the context of the ever-changing market economy, people's living standards are constantly improving, and the requirements for transportation are getting higher and higher. As the most common means of transportation, the safety and quality of automobiles are closely related to people's production and life. In recent years, my country's automotive engineering has made unprecedented progress. However, with the rapid development of science and technology, the information age has come. Some traditional technologies are no longer applicable and have been replaced by a number of new advanced technologies. Artificial intelligence technology is one of the high-tech. Its working principle is to simulate the thinking mode and behavior of the human brain and give reasonable related instructions. The extensive application of intelligent automation technology in automotive engineering can comprehensively improve the quality and safety of automotive manufacturing, and further promote the rapid development of the automotive industry.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Different Equalization Techniques for 4 ×4, 3×3, 2×2, 2×3, and 2×4 MIMO wireless communication systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: MIMO technology can enhance the channel capacity as a result huge number of data can be transmitted within a short span of time. The number of more antennas in the transmitter and receiver section is a source of the number of more channel capacity in the wireless communication system. Multiple antennas are used by the MIMO system in the transmitter and receiver section. This paper represents the performance of the different equalizer techniques for 4×4, 3×3, 2×2, 2×3, and 2×4 MIMO wireless communication systems under the Rayleigh fading channel. The main aim of this paper is to find out the minimum BER by comparing equalizers techniques with four 4×4, 3×3, 2×2, 2×3, and 2×4 MIMO wireless communication systems. All the modulation process is done by BPSK. Four equalizers are considered here those are MLSE, MMSE, ZF and MF-SIC. Simulation is done by MATLAB software.

articleTitle: GPS System based Tracking model for Mobile phone
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This application is employed to find a Lost mobile. It handles a new registration of the user with their name and alternative phone number and to acquire access. It Automatically takes the snap of the owner when the mobile phone is switched on. This application is used to report the Location of the device. If an android has purloined and the mugger changes the existing SIM card which is enrolled in the application then, immediately the details of Geographic locations are sent to the alternative phone number of the original user and also capture an image of a burglar to recognize him easily. In this research paper, both the situations of Tracking the stolen phone with existing SIM card and stolen phone with changed SIM card is tracked regularly. The registered mobile number gets an SMS alert from the theft mobile. This process is a real-time monitoring system to track an android mobile phone.

articleTitle: CAD based product packaging design scheme based on deformed shape image detection and quality assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: CAD based product packaging design scheme based on deformed shape image detection and quality assessment as the topic is discussed in the research. Information entropy represents the average amount of information in an image. It measures the amount of information in an image from the perspective of information theory. The image's entropy increases as the amount of information increases.. Through using this characteristic, this paper design the novel image demosaidng model to assist the evaluation of the image quality. The CAD combined system is applied for the packaging design scheme. In the experiment part, the robustness of the designed framework will be validated.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Bag of Password Authentication using Python, Java and PHP Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In today's world, the data storage is getting increased due to (i) business and banking information, (ii) personalized data, (iii) research improvements on the field of data retrieval, pattern and future prediction over the retrieved data, (iv) improvement in machine learning algorithms, (v) social media and (vi) higher e-mail transactions. If the information value is higher, then that increases possibility and attracts hacker towards the available or transacted information. This clearly says that the field area of research is very much in need to focus and further improvement towards authentication security. The authentication security can be provided by using some devices like (i) finger print sensor, (ii) face recognition devices, etc., but these leads to additional cost and additional device dependent which reduces the ease approach of authentication. When the authentication mechanism need to be improved without any additional sensors then the password entering scheme will come into the picture and this password entering mechanism can be researched and improved better. This leads to the found, bag of password approach. In the bag of password technique, the major issue found is on the end user side to remember multiple passwords for authentication purpose. This issue is been addressed by making the uniform distribution passwords and reducing probability of every password occurrence at least once. As a result here for the proposed technique, the best programmatic language will be selected from the three trending programming languages like PHP, Python and Java to implement and recommending those based on various aspects for authentication mechanism.

articleTitle: Visualization of regional resource advantage measurement based on physical network data analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Visualization of the regional resource advantage measurement based on physical network data analysis is studied in this paper. While communication technology improves cellular network service performance, it also brings new problems to the system; hence, this paper considers the novel perspectives. This research work traverses all possible combinations of MCS levels and repeated transmission times, and then selects an optimal combination. For the physical network, the random search model has been applied to collect the efficient data and the structure, and then the visualization process has been applied to conduct the comprehensive analysis task. In the experiment analysis, the proposed approach is compared with the different existing datasets. The features are well described.

articleTitle: Realization of Intelligent Auxiliary Guiding System of Ball Sports with Animation Simulation and Computer Graphics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Recently, the integration of the vision and guiding system is a emerging research hotspot. This paper studies the realization of intelligent auxiliary guiding system of ball sports with animation simulation and computer graphics. As the core factor of the proposed model, the motion analysis framework is essential. In this paper, the time dimension is sampled at exactly the same time interval, so the joint connection of the time dimension is regular and can be calculated according to the traditional convolution method, the FFT action is applied here to calculate the overall performance of the model. The simulation system is applied to show the overall performance. The intelligent graphic model is considered for the study of the system. The experiment is conducted which verifies the designed system can enhance the traditional guiding model.

articleTitle: In Distribution System Minimum Loss Reconfiguration using Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this article, a conceptual load flow model is designed with a MATLAB 2015a software. The proposed modelling system is mainly based on load distribution and power flow. This paper also examines the impact of higher load in a load flow distributed bus system. Further, the proposed research work explores the effect of damping minimization on steady-state time with respect to constant voltage amplitude. The developed hypercube architecture employs the ant colony optimization algorithm (ACO) to overcome the redistributing network losses.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of Hexapod leg with different controllers
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper presents the comparative study and analysis on the controllers for Hexapod. At present, there are several compliance control problems related to the hexapod robots under different conditions. These problems can be reduced by improving the strategy of the controller. The parameters such as position, speed and angular velocity simulations are taken for the analytical study of the controllers. Modelling, design and the simulation of DC servo motor are performed. The analysis of its performance using various controllers, which include closed loop, PID and Fuzzy controller is presented. Through the analysis of different parameters of the controller, a suitable controller can be identified. The efficient controller is then selected for the leg position control of the hexapod. It can be verified that the control strategy has great importance in order to enhance the capabilities of the hexapod robot.

articleTitle: Information Detection in Brain Using Wavelet Features and K-Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Brain signals provide information about the various activities happening in brain at the time of occurrence of different events. Information specifically known to a person can be assessed using electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. Recognition of specific domain knowledge can be useful for screening individuals by job placement and law enforcement agencies. An individual possessing specific domain knowledge in real life can benefit the society with his/her knowledge and can be distinguished from the individuals possessing no domain knowledge. There is a huge demand of computer science professionals in information technology organizations, government institutions, security agencies, research laboratories, and private organizations. Hence, in the present work it is proposed to detect the knowledge of computer science in the subjects using brain signals. The text stimuli related to computer science domain was presented to the participants on a computer screen. Wavelet decomposition was used to extract features in the delta frequency band of EEG signals. Principal component analysis (PCA) gives reduced dimensionality of wavelet features and leads to better classification than the original features. It is observed that k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) classifier performs significantly better than other classifiers with a classification accuracy of 80%. These results show the efficacy and easy implementation of wavelet features with k-NN classifier in effectively recognizing the experts of a particular field.

articleTitle: Development of network informatization of traditional crafts based on computer technology
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Development of the network informatization of traditional crafts based on computer technology is studied with systematic verification in this paper. At present, the basic logic of the Internet is a distributed and shared model. However, today's cloud computing model is increasingly deviating from this logic of the Internet to a certain extent, and has brought about the monopoly of computing power, data hegemony, and security issues. To this idea, this paper combines the computer model with the network framework. The data model with the the neural network is combined for the optimal modelling. The structure of the model is validated through the experiment.

articleTitle: Content based Image Retrieval using Optimal Deep Learning with Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Background: In recent times, content-based image retrieval (CBIR) remains a hot research topic due to the popularity of Internet and low-cost imaging technologies. In CBIR, the query image (QI) gets matched with the visual details of the images kept in the dataset, and the images with maximum similarity are retrieved. The advent of artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) models enables to effective design of the CBIR model. Purpose: In this view, this paper presents an optimal DL based VGG-16 model with grasshopper optimization algorithm (DLVGG-GOA) for CBIR. Methods: The presented model involves the DL based VGG-16 model for the extraction of feature vectors of the applied input query image (QI) and the images in the database. In order to increase the effective performance of the VGG-16 model, the GOA is applied for adjusting the hyperparameters of the VGG-16 model. Upon inputting a QI, the presented model extracts the feature vectors and matches the similarity measurement using Minkowski distance with the images that exist in the database. Finally, the images with higher similarity get retrieved effectively from the database. Results: The retrieval performance of the DLVGG-GOA model is validated using the benchmark database and examines the results interms of distinct measures. Conclusion: The obtained retrieval results ensured the improved effectiveness of the DLVGG-GOA model on the applied test images.

articleTitle: Analog Analysis of Novel Ferroelectric-Dual Material Oxide Stack-Double Gate FET
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this work, the analog performance for Ferroelectric-Dual Material Oxide Stack-Double Gate FET (Fe-DMOS-DG FET) has been assessed and its effectiveness in reducing short channel effects (SCEs) has been analyzed. The obtained results have been compared with the conventional MOSFET having the same channel length. This research work utilizes gate metal comprising of two different materials to have better control over the channel. To reduce the injection of hot carriers, in one case a ferroelectric layer is used on a thin SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> interface layer, and in another case, a ferroelectric layer is used on an oxide stack consisting of high k-dielectric and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as gate dielectric material. Parameters like ON current, OFF current, Ion/Ioff current ratio, Id vs. Vg plot, Transconductance vs. Vg plot. threshold voltage. and sub-threshold slope are considered. It has been recorded that the new device has less subthreshold current, resulting in a lower subthreshold slope when compared to bulk MOSFET. Also, the electric field and carrier concentration along the channel are investigated. and it has been found that the novel device enhances carrier transport in the channel. The silvaco ATLAS device simulation software is used to do the numerical calculations in order to validate the results.

Author Keywords: Ferroelectric-Dual Material Oxide Stack-Double Gate FET (Fe-DMOS-DG FET)

articleTitle: Automatic detection of sewer defects via hierarchical deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Sewer pipeline damage is one of the most serious issues faced today. Damage to a sewage system can result in a variety of problems, including traffic congestion caused by contaminated roadways and the spread of waste water on the roads and adjacent areas. Also, these untreated sewer damages cause many other problems such as they make the water impure to use when the wastewater mixes with the drinkable and usable water and also cause threat to the aquatic animals and marine life. The leakage releases bad odor into the atmosphere. This also leads to the cause of many diseases due to the use of the impure water and also the bacteria and other pathogens that are carried by the sewages includes Cholera, Typhoid, dysentery and many other diseases causing germs and viruses. Most of the sewers with lifespan of 25-30 years and older are getting damaged easily also the sewer damages are mostly due to the impose of overweight on the sewer pipelines and underground pressure on the pipelines are causing cracks, fractures, gouges and corrosion to the sewer pipelines. The pipelines of more lifespan should be replaced. So early detection of sewer damages and replacement of sewer pipelines is very important. As a result, people can overcome the aforementionedissues and impacts of sewer damage.

articleTitle: Smart Health Monitoring System Using ANN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Nowadays, automation and IOT plays a key role in changing the world. Because of IOT our life gets simpler and automated day-by-day which causes mutiny in present day technology. In recent era due to a hectic schedule and uneven way of life, health problem is not relying on age factor. Under these conditions, IOT has provided an extraordinary result to monitor the health condition of individuals at their home itself. The data of different parameters regarding patient's health is obtained using sensors and it is stored by IOT and displayed through an application which gives ingress for remote monitoring. Sensors lessen the human error, and this system reduces the space occupancy. The identical part of our project is, it is alternative way of monitoring health problems and providing the solutions which is automatically generated by the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of DC-DC Power Converter for Fuel cell Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The Fuel cells are more often clean energy resource for most of the industrial needs. This clean energy will have a numerous aspect in our life, and the basic applications like utility power, transportation, low power devices as laptops, PC, and many small power applications. To empower the use of fuel cells, the high-power converters are to be used for industrial and commercial sectors like transportation. The utilization of these cells mainly depends on the dc power converters. At present a full-bridge converter is the overwhelming geography in high gain power DC-DC applications. Already a wide variety of multiphase converters have been proposed in the recent time, but their device characteristic is not optimistic for a low voltage source like fuel cell. This paper mainly discusses one of the recent research articles on 3-phase high gain soft switched DC-DC converter with fuel cell as a input, and the performance of converter is been analyses by non-linear loads like RL and Induction motor.

articleTitle: Smart Posture Detector Using IOT
