abstract: In Mobile Crowdsensing, often it is observed that the quality of data; that are obtained from the participants of the crowdsensed network is not the same as the desired data. There can be multiple reasons for this; firstly the reward given to the participants is not enough; secondly even in voluntary participation, the participants do not get involved in the cause. In either case, it is highly required to cater the needs of the users considering it as the backbone of the mobile crowdsensing network. So this paper focuses on both the aspects. Recommended tasks will be given to the contributors of the system based on their categorization, and they will be allowed to choose the task. Also, for rewarding the users; they will be given premium for their participation work, as well for sensing the environment. Knowing that the crowdsensing works in a stochastic environment; an effort has been done for sensing the abode considering the dynamic and mobile nature of the system. The results also show that the overall quality of the data get improved in this.

articleTitle: PCSOA-MZI Based All-Optical Half Adder
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Photonic crystal semiconductor optical amplifier (PC-SOA) with Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) configuration is used to construct all-optical AND XOR gates. Half adder is broadly used as an arithmetic logical unit in optical communications. The XOR & AND logic units are the primary devices used in the all-optical half adder structure design. The performance of XOR & AND gates is numerically examined in terms of the extinction ratio (ER) and contrast ratio (CR) at a data speed of 500 Gbps. Calculated values ensure both logical correctness and acceptable quality to support high data rate communication.

articleTitle: Design of Leakage Resilient and DPA Attack Immune Architecture of S BOX
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Electronic gadgets such as mobile phones, laptops, IPad, home appliances and other gaming gadgets have become a part and parcel of our life and they have made the human life most comfortable. With the shirking of technology the gadgets have become handy and security of the devices is taken care by the field of cryptography. One of the best Cryptographic algorithm secured the data is Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) which is a combination of various steps. One of the major action involved in making the encryption is by Substitution of data with the help of Substitution box called as S Box. The threat on to the chips fabricated is Side Channel Attacks (SCA) and the popular SCA attacks are Differential Power Analysis (DPA). In cryptographic systems such are Smart cards, RFID tags, military applications and E-commerce applications cryptography plays a vital role. In this paper a Low power adiabatic logic with attack immunity is used to construct a Sub Byte transformation called as S Box of AES. It is implemented and found that the energy dissipated is reduced by 26% and 44% against the NDDPL and PFSAL Techniques. The efficiency of the proposed Dual Rail Single Clock Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic (Dual Rail SCPFAL) S Box is verified by comparing it with the PFSAL based Rijndael S-Box. The DPA attack immunity is verified with the help of an efficiency factor called Coefficient of Deviation (CoD) or ϵ and is improved by 32% and 48% against NDDPL and PFSAL logic. The proposal is implemented and results are verified in Cadence Virtuoso 45nm technology and the power and current traces are compared at different temperature.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Tri-Band Stop FSS for Medical Instruments Shielding Application
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This article focuses on a polarization - freelance Tri- stop band FSS in case of sensible medical instrument approach. FR-4 substrate is used to construct Frequency Selective Surface (FSS) structure, using that behavior FSS act as a band stop filter for the frequencies of 2.4 GHz, 1.8GHz and 5GHz. The three band-stop frequency area unit severally controlled by standardization the building block mathematical framework. The building block manifest a consistent form in order to alter constant affording in each mode of TE and atomic number (0°_60°) for the wave incident and also the stability of the system at different angles are verified. The simulation result is analyzed for the TE and TM mode polarization coefficient and Transmission coefficient for the incident angle varies from 0° to 60°. The high frequencies stop band response achieved by increasing the angle of incident. The planned building block configuration is created by the use of CST studio software. The characteristics of tri band FSS is confirmed by matching it with the simulation result.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection system in Software defined Network using machine learning approach - Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the rapid development of internet in recent years, the networks are growing in size every day. As the networks are growing day by day, the task of managing the networks, effectively and efficiently also become a matter of concern. In case of traditional networks, due to their static nature, it is difficult to monitor the entire network efficiently and so now focus started shifting towards a new architecture that is Software defined networks. Being programmable in nature, SDN overcame a lot of shortcomings of traditional networks, however, the security of the network still remains the point of concern. The controller which is considered as the brain of SDN architecture can be taken as the prime target by attackers in order to attack the entire network. Therefore, in order to provide a robust mechanism for securing the networks, machine learning based intrusion detection systems came into picture. The proposed survey will provide an overview of software defined networks, intrusion detection systems and machine learning algorithms. The performance of machine learning algorithms that have been used recently by the researchers are compared. Also, this paper has highlighted the various challenges.

articleTitle: A Quick Review of ML Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Machine Learning is considered to be an offset of artificial intelligence that is associated with the design and development of algorithms that will make computers to learn behaviors based on the given data. In today's world, Machine Learning finds application in all streams, be it medical, academics, automobile and so on. Henceforth, this research work has attempted to make the readers understand thoroughly all the different machine learning algorithms ranging from classification till reinforcement learning. To name some of them are Supervised Learning, Unsupervised Learning, Semi-supervised Learning and Reinforcement Learning.

articleTitle: PFD with Dead zone based Low Power Modified Phase Lock Loop using AVLS Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Phase lock loop (PLL) operates at higher frequency and due to the increased switching, the power consumed is high. The increase in demand of applications in communications systems has led to fully integrated, minimal power and high performance PLL. There is a demand for low power applications and hence various methods have been emerging. The power of the PLL has to be reduced and optimized by reducing the power of all the sub-blocks of PLL. Adaptive voltage level (AVLS) technique is incorporated in the circuit to reduce power consumption. The phase detector of the PLL is replaced with a phase frequency detector with dead zone which is used to reduce the power of the PLL. The number of transistors is also reduced thereby reducing the area of the PLL. Also MOSFETs are used for the design of loop filter. The circuits are realized using CMOS 180nm technology in Cadence Virtuoso and simulated using Cadence Spectre. Proposed modified PLL architecture's is compared w.r.t. reference PLL architectures at various frequencies. Proposed PLL architectures consumes very less power compared to reference PLL architectures even at higher frequency (>1 GHz).

articleTitle: Simulation of PID and Fuzzy Logic Controllers for Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper investigates the design and development of PID and fuzzy logic controllers employed in boost converter. The design calculation of different component/parameters, specifically the inductor and the capacitor has been performed to make sure on the continuous conduction mode operation of the converter circuit. The circuit is implemented using MATLAB/Simulink and the results are drawn and presented in the paper. The simulation results verifies that Fuzzy logic controller provides better transient responses and satisfactory steady-state performances. The effect of output with fluctuations in the input voltage is analysed for which the input is varied between Vin= 30 V to Vin =60 V. Moreover, the effect due to change in load is also studied by varying the load. The fuzzy logic shows less load voltage changes due to changes in input.

articleTitle: Reliability Testing of Piezoelectric Transducer Based Rotational Energy Harvesting in Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Alternative clean energy sources for vehicle is the center of attention in the recent decades. It is possible to utilize the generally lost energy into an alternate useful form. One such way is to harness the lost energy and convert it as a useful resource. In this research work the mechanical strain or the pressure on the tyres of trucks is converted into useful electrical energy. Piezo energy harvesters are used to extract this pressure-based energy and convert them into useful electrical energy. The harnessed energy can be used for various applications. Reliability study on piezoelectric module is conducted to assess the energy that can be harvested, and an extrapolation study is performed to assess for the future requirement.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Lip Movement Technique for Mute
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: There is a significant change in technology, virtual reality (VR) has been used in this article as the simplest way of visual activity and interaction technique which provides visual nodal options supported by the automated lip-reading technology. With this advancement in the technology, the state of the human can be identified and captured through the lip movements. Deep Learning is used to analyze the real time thinking of the human visual choices. Using image processing technique, virtual reality technology is used to identify the driver's visual features and evaluate the critical time thinking. The ancient lip-reading recognition system, the need for responsive applications is difficult to fulfill. Deep Learning is now the emerging technique of artificial intelligence which acts as a normal human brain with the thinking capability. It consists of different layers which are used to evaluate the details like neurons in brain. In this article, the surface area of the lip is taken as the key element or the key feature of the lip movement. The horizontal distance and the vertical distance of the lips are used to calculate the surface area. This surface area is then used to estimate some parameter and store in the database. Based on the results, the accuracy is more than 85%. Therefore, our proposed system is more effective and more efficient than other traditional methods.

articleTitle: On-The-Fly Key Generation Based VLSI Implementation of Advanced Encryption Standard
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Data transmitted in a digital format is vulnerable to breaches. Here, the FPGA-based Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) architecture is proposed to safeguard high speed data. 128 and 256-bit keys are supported by this implementation. This execution is recursive and processes single block of data containing 128 bits. Giving access towards a series of round keys and a block, the encipher and decipher block handling data paths are isolated. This opens the door to toughen the core wire just to encrypt or decrypt the mechanism. This helps the synthesis/build toolkits to optimize the necessary functionalities which limits the size to around 50 percent. It has been inspected to ensure the complete removal of decryption, and the core is still functioning. This is an implementation that is extremely compact. The design considerations proposed here enable users to build a trade-off between speed, use of resources and consumption of power. The proposed design is evaluated on various FPGA devices and is compared with several existing AES implementations showing area and power optimized through this method.

articleTitle: PROGNOSTICATION OF DIABETES USING DATA MINING MODELS
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Background: Diabetes is an assimilative disease that could cause soaring in the levels of blood sugar. This un diagnosed rise in blood sugar from diabetes could damage a human beings nerves, eyes, kidneys, and other internal organs. Objectives: The following study is conducted in order to pinpoint and bestow a method for prompt prognostication of diabetes by making use of data mining tools. Methods: The data used was gathered under the Countenance of a doctor by using resolute questionnaires among patients of Sylhet Diabetes Hospital which is situated in Sylhet, Bangladesh. 16 instances were accumulated in this dataset. Algorithms namely Bagging, Sequential Minimal Optimization (SMO), Naïve Bayes, Instance Based method based on K-neighbor's (IBK), Random forest are used for comparison of the prediction of diabetes. Result: On collation of the 5 algorithms used WEKA, which is a data mining tool, the accuracy has been calculated for each of the algorithms with respect to their Tp-rate, Fp-rate, precision and recall rates. Conclusion: On appraisal of the results procured, it provides the ability to come to a culmination that the IBK algorithm is the best algorithm based on the accuracy and performance, while comparing it with the other models.

articleTitle: Ontology Based Disease Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Nowadays people are facing new diseases due to the environmental conditions and their living habits. Generally, the diseases are recognized by the symptoms that our body creates. The reason of a disease can vary from one person to the next. However, ignorance is a common cause of most diseases, and is caused by a lack of awareness of the symptoms that the human body indicates. So, the prediction of disease at early stage becomes important task. With the help of ontology, this project essentially provides information about various symptoms and diseases. The developed ontology includes diseases and their relationships with symptoms, as well as SPARQL (SPARQL and RDF Query Language) queries for disease prediction. The developed ontology in this project has two stages. Defining classes, subclasses, and data, as well as object properties, is the first step. Then created ontology file will be uploaded to the apache jena fuseki server. The second part is executing SPARQL queries from the server which extracts the diseases with symptoms based on the query written. And here, we are generating graphical representation of ontology using onto Graf.

articleTitle: Minkowski Fractal Boundary Patch Antenna for GPS Application
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A Minkowski fractal boundary patch antenna is nominated for L1 band GPS applications. The Minkowski fractal curves are substituted at the sides of the square patch for size miniaturization. The main objective of the proposed work is to design compact GPS antenna by employing fractal concept. The Minkowski iteration order 1 and iteration order 2 are studied. The proposed antennas are simulated using HFSS simulation tool. An impedance bandwidth of 6.9 % (1.52-1.63 GHz) and 5 % (1.53-1.61 GHz) are achieved with the iteration order 1 and iteration order 2 Minkowski fractal antennas.

articleTitle: Low power Front-End amplifiers-A Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Due to the commercial use of battery-powered portable devices, low power circuits are required. A low power, low noise front end is the important key for various battery-operated devices for real-world applications. In this review paper, various modifications of popular front-end with their performance parameters like CMRR, PSRR, slew rate, power dissipation, etc. have been studied. The comparison between different topologies of front-end amplifiers to have more power-efficient, low noise, high gain, and better bandwidth at low supply voltages to be analyzed. This review paper provides an assessment of low power front end amplifiers.

articleTitle: Design, Implementation and Performance Comparison of D- Latch Using Different Topologies
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)

authors.preferredName: P. S. V. N. K. Mani Gupta

abstract: This article provides the comparison results of the D-latch circuit in three different topologies i.e. conventional CMOS (Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor), MCML (MOS Current Mode Logic), and BD-MCML (Bulk Driven-MOS Current Mode Logic). In the BD-MCML circuit, the bulk terminal is also used as one of the inputs. The voltage levels of input should not affect the operation of the MOSFET. In BD-MCML, the dynamic power is independent of frequency, So it can be used in high frequency applications with less power consumption. The comparison is made by considering the supply voltage for all the circuits to be 0.8 V. The performance of D- Latch with different topologies is evaluated and analyzed using Cadence Virtuoso tool in 45nm technology. In this paper, the performance analysis and comparison is done using three different parameters; power, delay, and PDP (Power Delay Product). This paper concludes that BD-MCML has better performance with respect to power and PDP as compared to the other topologies,

articleTitle: A circularly polarized microstrip patch antenna using circular parasite patches
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A circularly polarized microstrip patch antenna with circular parasite patches with a simplified feed network is discussed in this paper. It can operate in the frequency which comes under x band that is from 8-12 GHZ. One of the most common types of antennas used in satellite communications is the microstrip patch antenna. It is comprised of a metallic “patch” on top of the dielectric substrate and the ground plane underneath the dielectric material. The axial ratio and other parameters are improved by using circular parasitic patches. The dimensions of the propounded antenna are 0.93λ0× 0.93λ0 × 0.017λ0 (whereλ0 is the space wavelength proportionate to the center frequency of 10.4 GHz).

articleTitle: A NEW APPROACH FOR ENERGY - EFFICIENT COOPERATIVE ROUTING METHOD FOR WIRELESS SENSOR NETWORKS
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The EERH in heterogeneous WSNs is a complex routing system. Until sending these packets to their sinks, various events are identified, and where as event packets are transferred to the same address are inserted. Along the communication routes, Type A sensors will transmit Type B packets. When a packet is sent, a nearby sensor helps to relay P. In the general approach, each message and the message of the digitialized signature is generated with the private key of sender is transmitted. Every intermediate forwarder and recipient can authenticate the message with the public key of the sender. In terms of memory utilization, message sophistication, and protection tolerance, public applications' latest advancements may be more useful, as public- specific approaches provide an easy and clean key management. It will save resources in transferring P to your sink as the sensors that will transmit packets in order to achieve the event packets rises for a particular WSN. As we note, where as the energy consumption(E) is proportional to d2 where d be the distance from wireless transmission for packet distribution. According to our simulation, the EERH extends sensor existence and allows the relaying possibilities in a heterogeneous wireless sensor networks are more versatile. It allows the sensors in the environment to track and relay activities reliably such that the tracking existence of networks is essentially increased. Besides, when we use the EERH, we will change its parameters to suit the monitoring environment requirements.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Elliptical Array Antenna with Flat Top Beam using Multi-Verse Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This article deals with the synthesis of uniformly spaced elliptical array antenna using multi-verse optimization algorithm. Two cases are performed here. In case 1 a uniform elliptical array antenna is optimized to obtain a flat top beam pattern with 20 numbers of array elements and a specific semimajor axis value. In case 2, a 40 element elliptical array is designed with optimized semi-major axis. For both the cases the current excitation amplitude is varied within a specific boundary value to get the flat top shape in the radiation pattern. Case 1 mainly focuses on minimizing the ripple in the main beam and case 2 focuses on reducing the side lobes. The challenge of this study is to produce a flat-top pattern with a negligible amount of ripple in the main beam and lower side lobes which can essentially be applied with benefit of constant intensity over a given cross-section. The study shows the robustness of the algorithm and the usefulness of the considered optimization technique.

articleTitle: Voice Prescription with End-to-End Security Enhancements
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The recent analysis indicates more than 250,000 people in the United States of America (USA) die every year because of medical errors. World Health Organisation (WHO) reports states that 2.6 million deaths occur due to medical and its prescription errors. Many of the errors related to the wrong drug/dosage administration by caregivers to patients due to indecipherable handwritings, drug interactions, confusing drug names, etc. The espousal of Mobile-based speech recognition applications will eliminate the errors. This allows physicians to narrate the prescription instead of writing. The application can be accessed through smartphones and can be used easily by everyone. An application program interface has been created for handling requests. Natural language processing is used to read text, interpret and determine the important words for generating prescriptions. The patient data is stored and used according to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) guidelines. The SMS4-BSK encryption scheme is used to provide the data transmission securely over Wireless LAN.

articleTitle: A study on Skin care product detection using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Every day, there is a new progress in science and technology. The new technologies are also deploying a profound impact on the cosmetic industry by introducing a slew of new skin care products. As a result, there is a great deal of uncertainty before purchasing the cosmetic items. The suggested system assists in developing a novel application to assist the user in resolving the appropriate product selection issues. The developed application works in such a manner that the user must scan or upload the ingredient included in the product and it is highly required to submit some basic information about their skin. A skin care product detection system is utilized to properly predict and analyse the suitability of the product to the consumer.

articleTitle: AI Based Chabot for Appliance Control
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The theme of this paper is to design a chatbot with Artificial Intelligence and IOT to control the home appliances from anywhere anytime. This research work designs a chatbot in existing platform. Also., the proposed research work utilizes Raspberry Pi., PIR Sensor., Gas sensor., sensor to detect light and raspberry pi camera at the remote end and also telegram bot is used to communicate with the home appliances. The telegram cloud will connect the home appliances with the telegram bot. The theme of this paper is to provide enhanced user experience under the combination of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and use of the internet of Things (IOT). Here python idle is used to code and VNC viewer is used at the backend to run the program. With the assistance of the Artificial Intelligence, the chatbot can automatically process the knowledge or commands given by the user. The utilization of AI alongside the web Of Things will make the utilization of home automation system simpler and faster. Also it makes the interface simpler. This paper incorporates Artificial Intelligence [AI] for chatbot and Internet of Things [IoT] for controlling the house appliances. This research work will be controlling the sunshine (i.e.) user gets notified if the lights are on during daylight and therefore the user can off or on the lights according to his need. Then the Raspberry Pi Camera will monitor the door using the PIR motion sensor. Just in case any motion is detected at the door step., the camera will then capture the image and will send it to the registered user”s mobile. Then the user can either use this chatbot to open or close the door automatically. Then MQ2 semiconductor sensor for combustible gas is used here to monitor the leakage of gas reception at home and immediately, it'll alarm the user about the leakage. By following this way, user can monitor the house safe, smart and secure.

articleTitle: A Robust Bangla Spell Checker for Search Engine
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The spell-checking system assists to detect spelling-errors and advise the appropriate corrections in the word documents automatically. This paper is concerned with the implementation of an interactive Bangla spell checking tool, and demonstrating how to use it in a general-purpose search engine effectively. From the literature, it is seen that Bangla has complex grammatical and orthographical rules for spelling, and the study addressed different challenges in generating suggestions for Bangla phonetic-errors. The study also presented a combined technique of the string-matching algorithm and a reverse dictionary lookup method for detecting the typographical-errors as well as cognitive phonetic-errors in Bangla language. Both algorithms have been implemented into a search engine app for locating a misspelled word, and listing the suggested candidate-words. Finally, the intended word is chosen from the candidate words that were generated by the spell checker, and used it for searching in the search engine platform. Two-level of databases (the lexicon and secondary database) were used to design the proposed system. The lexicon database contains about 58,319 correctly spelled Bangla words, and a secondary database contains about 46,881 stemmed-key data.

articleTitle: Design of Successive cancellation List Decoding of Polar Codes
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Due to the introduction of 5G, the Polar codes have attracted researchers in the communication field. It is one of a linear block error-correcting codes. This is a kind of Information channel coding techniques with low-complexity in nature wherein the encoding and decoding operation will be performed. Moreover, when it is considered in theoretical prospective, this is considered as one of the capacitive achieving algorithm for a wide range of channel. Polar codes are shown to be instances of concatenated codes. It is proved that the effect of a polar code can be increased by showing the multistage decoding algorithm with log likelihood based Successive List decoding (SCL). As for as Frame error rate is concerned the SCL decoding is not an optimal solution. In this paper the performance of polar codes concatenated with CRC codes is presented and it is proved that it outperforms turbo or LDPC codes. The simulation result shows that with the sufficient amount of training this method can provide a lower frame-error rate for different code lengths.

articleTitle: Intelligent Path Planning and Obstacle Avoidance Algorithms for Autonomous Vehicles Based on Enhanced RRT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This manuscript studies the intelligent path planning and obstacle avoidance algorithms for autonomous vehicles based on enhanced RRT algorithm. The selection of the optimal path in this research gives priority to security, so the function of the weight value of each cost function is designed according to the threshold of the security cost function. When the value of the security cost function is above the threshold, the security is low. With this replacement, the traditional RRT is implemented with the genetic algorithms and the neural computation model is combined for the accuracy concern. The designed model is tested on the random data sets. Compared with the traditional RRT, the neural network based model and the fuzzy planning based model, the proposed is efficient.

articleTitle: Design and synthesis of Karatsuba multiplier using Square root carry select adder (SRCSA)
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper mainly described about design and synthesis of 16-bit Karatsuba multiplier using Square root carry select adder (SRCSA) circuit. The Carry look ahead adder (CLA), Carry save adder (CSA) and SRCSA are modelled using Verilog HDL. The functional verification of all the adders is carried out in Cadence NClaunch tool. All the adders are synthesized in Cadence Genus tool. The power, timings and area reports can be generated in the synthesis flow. The comparative analysis done between CLA, CSA and SRCSA. Later choose SRCSA for the multiplier. The Karatsuba multiplier is designed using the Verilog HDL. The functional verification of the multiplier circuit is carried using Verilog (RTL file) and test bench in NCLaunch tool from cadence. The synthesis of multiplier circuit is carried in Genus tool from Cadence, it converts the RTL file to gate-level netlist. During synthesis, reported the power is 193385.696 nW, Delay is 3409ps and area is 2795.508nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. All process has been carried out using the 180nm technology.

articleTitle: Property Driven Design based Verification for Register Transfer Level Hardware
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The amount of features that could be put on a chip grew as a result of many innovations and developments. As a result, much more functional complexity is created. This motivates the need for architectural advancements with increased productivity. The “Property-Driven Design (PDD)” approach for Register Transfer Level i.e.,RTL hardware is described in this paper, which begins with aconceptual interface model and introduces property checking early in the design process. The proposed PDD approach generates abstracts properties from system architecture and uses them during the design phase to save time and effort on property testing. The new approach has a major benefit in that it provides an explicitly sound device model in addition to the RTL definition. By simplifying some complex research and evaluation activities in today's modern design flows, this helps to emancipate system-level models from mere models to golden concept models. Path predicate abstraction (PPA) produces time and abstract system models that could be combined to form abstract modeling techniques.

articleTitle: Designing of an ultra-sensitive fiber-optic sensor for the bacterial analysis of drinking water
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This work proposes a novel and highly-sensitive optical device to sense the presence of different pathogenic bacteria in drinking water. The initial sensing structure consists of a decladded multimode fiber with a higher order Bessel-Gauss beam shining on it. It relies on the notion of intermodal interference, where the transmitted output power varies with changeable cladding refractive index because of different pathogenic bacteria as present in the water sample. For the designing of bacteria sensor, such coalescence of higher order Bessel-Gauss beam along with a decladded multimode fiber has never been mentioned in any of the existing literatures. The device's sensing behavior was substantiated using a finite difference Eigenmode analysis in Mode solution software (commercially available from Lumerical Inc., Canada). By selecting the sensing length as 7 cm, the obtained spectral sensitivity of 1179 dB/RII is 3.78 times superior to the typical Gaussian sensor. Therefore such an emerging beam known as higher-order beam Bessel-Gauss offers new prospects in the biosensing field.

articleTitle: Smart Emergency Vehicle Plan with App Monitoring and Centralized Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this rapidly developing technological world, effective automated traffic systems are becoming a requirement. The present-day traffic signals require an efficient communication system for increased efficiency in response time to emergency vehicles. The proposed system not only eliminates the waiting period of emergency vehicles but also reduces the response time to emergency vehicles. Each node consists of a traffic signal system employed at a junction having a unique identification number which in turn is connected to a centralized network architecture constructed around a single server. This server in turn is connected and contains information of all nodes in a specific region. The traffic signal system is designed such that it tackles the delay in response and communication interruption that may occur with the help of the centralized server connected to them. The server plays a vital role in calculating the distance between the approaching emergency vehicle and the traffic signal and instructs the corresponding traffic signal which thereby turns the signal at the respective lane green. The range and the type of indicators in the emergency plan can be altered depending on the signal junction requirements. In case of interruption in communication between the server and the traffic signal due to climatic conditions or system failure, the traffic signal could be controlled via a mobile application developed. The various methods implemented to control the traffic signal are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Film and Television Advertisements Recommendation System Based on Digital Media and Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Design of modern intelligent film and television advertisements recommendation system based on digital media and decision tree is studied in this paper. The characteristic of rough set theory is that there is no need to specify the general quantitative description of certain characteristics and attributes in advance, and it directly starts from the description set of the given problem, through just the data structure and the pattern of the framework to construct the model. Hence, it is applied to the recommendation of smart data. Further, the data processing models are applied to pre-process the datasets, and then the intelligent model is combined for performing a comprehensive analysis. Here, the proposed model is applied on the multimedia systems. The comparison results have shown satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Intelligent Accident Prevention and Detection for Four -Wheeler
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: To construct a zone for unique automated accident detection and prevention for four wheelers as soon as the accident site is detected. With the assistance of RTVT (real time vehicle) many lives can be saved during the accident. The primary goal of this propsoed model is to locate the exact site of accidents and send the ambulance to the correct location, as well as to reduce traffic so that the ambulance arrives on time at the hospitals. There have been several instances of passengers being involved in an accident on the ground, with many of them losing their lives as a result of the non-availability of ambulance at the accident spot and getting delayed in reaching the hospital. The information will not be left unaddressed. There is no appropriate mechanism for identifying and informing within a proper time to SMS service, which is primarily intended for notification and other reasons. The proposed research work has used GPS and GSM for location identification. The GSM initiates its processing to send the accident location. The major goal of this research work is to use GPS to identify the exact site of the accident so that an ambulance can be dispatched in a timely manner. The RF receiver is used here to alternatively transfer the signal when the signal has been received from ambulance to change the signal from red to green. This process aims to save more time and prevent the people from accidents.

articleTitle: Mellitus Preliminary Analysis using Various Data Mining Algorithms and Metrics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: s-Diabetes mellitus, also called diabetes, is a metabolic disease that causes increased blood sugar. In diabetic patients, insulin is taken, as this hormone transfers sugar into the cells from the blood. At an early stage, prediction of diabetes can lead to better treatment. It is possible to predict diabetes using data mining, deep learning, machine learning, etc. Data mining is widely used for prediction, prognosis, analysis, risk factors. The proposed research work is primarily focused on the prediction of diabetes in patients in this paper, based on highest accuracy. It is possible to use classification methods based on diabetic data to predict the outcome or to discover whether or not the patient is affected. Throughout this document, a predictive model has been developed by utilizing five data mining classification model, like Naive Bayes, SMO, Multiclass, Random Forest, IBK, to predict early stage diabetes and calculate accuracy. All five algorithms are measured on different metrics, i.e, Accuracy, Recall, Precision.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technology in Intelligent Pushing Urban Tourism Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data and information, the smart tourism industry has achieved rapid development. At present, tourism authorities and enterprises should change their development concepts. Hence, this paper considers the application of the data mining technology in intelligent pushing urban tourism information system. Firstly, the intelligent system has been designed from the data perspective, where the fuzzy data mining and the pushing information collection systems are both studied. Then, the data analytic model is applied. The proposed model has been tested and compared with the latest models. The pushing efficiency and QoS are guaranteed.

articleTitle: Securing Multimedia Content Using Watermark and Digital Signature
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the increasing rate of multimedia usages, many processes have been introduced to ensure the safety of their contents. Digital signature and watermarking are the processes that are used in cryptography and digital image transmission respectively. These two techniques can be combined for secure multimedia transmission. Over the years, these technologies have been able to secure the data of text documents but securing multimedia contents have been a difficult task. Therefore, this research proposed to use the digital signature and watermarking to secure multimedia data. The multimedia data is embedded with another data and is transmitted after encrypting it using the cryptographic algorithms. The receiver end decrypts the data and extracts the original data from the watermark. For digital watermarking, various transformations have been suggested. In this exploration, Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) has been used as it shows better results in digital watermarking applications.

articleTitle: An ultra-wideband (UWB) MIMO Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, a compact (20×20×1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) dual-port steering wheel shape multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) patch antenna is suitable for K & Ka band applications and in particular for 5G applications is presented. Three simulated antenna designs (Ant-1, Ant-2 and Ant-3) are systematically investigated and the specifications of Ant-3 have been optimized for desired antenna parameters and operation. Ultra-wideband (22.77-29.11 GHz) at port-1 and (22.66-29.11 GHz) at port-2 with impedance bandwidth of 24.44 % and 24.91 % respectively is observed. Maximum peak gain of 3.83 dBi at both port-1 and port-2 is observed. Simulated isolation less than − 20 dB, maximum envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) is 0.0011, diversity gain (DG) between 9.997-9.999 (dB), total active reflection coefficient (TARC) is less than −10 dB and radiation efficiency more than 70 % is obtained.

articleTitle: Arduino Base Ultrasonic Map -Maker
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This work is a supportive one for driverless vehicles which are going to be a boon for upcoming generation. This project is one such work that paves the way to avoid accidents in driverless vehicles. This work uses RADAR based Ultrasonic sensors (HC-SR04) and Servo Motor for the detection of obstacles at desired distance. This also enables the options of sending SMS to the concerned person about the distance of the object, camera to view the live video of the object, also can be equipped with Wi-Fi connection between android and Arduino for monitoring. The other important domains are the defense systems, and this can also be used in the dark sites for navigations

articleTitle: Li-Fi based Data Transmission for Underwater Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Communication imparts a major role in the survival of mankind. Communication rather than being a survival, it is being identified as basic purpose of understanding between every organism for their safe and healthy well-being. Earlier Electromagnetic (EM) waves were used for communication. But later, it was realized that these waves were less efficient. Here, this research work mainly focuses on the concept of data transmission. Li-Fi (Light Fidelity) was new to everyone a decade before, but now it's one of the emerging methodologies. The medium selected for data transmission is water. Unlike Wi-Fi, here the data will be transmitted without the need of internet and it also opts for wireless connectivity. The present system utilizes Li-Fi with the high complexity circuit, which is very inappropriate in their implementation for underwater communication. Hence, it necessitates the need to develop a system, which can be cost-effective as well as reduced area complexity in the arrangement of such a setup. The main focus of this paper is to bring up an experimental model which could achieve better transmission of Data with cost-effectiveness. The Li-Fi technology for Underwater Communication is proposed to achieve the expected target. The limiting facto with respect to the proposed methodology is that the interference of input light should happen without any disturbance to ensure maximum transmission.

articleTitle: E-SEEK - RFID based Detection System for Localizing the Misplaced Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper demonstrates how the E-Seek model assists in locating misplaced objects for industrial and domestic places. Using ultra high frequency passive RFID Tags and readers help in location tracking of assets is done. The random real time inputs generated using python and it's graphical interfaces, RawTurtle via Tkinter helps in the simulation of the distance and direction of the tags.

articleTitle: Quad-Port Circularly Polarized MIMO Antenna for K band Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, a compact (25×25×1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) four-port Hammer shaped patch antenna for K band (18-27GHz) applications is presented. Hammer shaped antenna work as band pass filter (BPF)) filtenna works like a communicating antenna for interweave CR (cognitive radio). The proposed antenna has| S11| less than −10 dB impedance bandwidth of 14.20% (20.86-24.05GHz) & 14.31<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> (20.96-24.19)at port 1 & port 4 respectively. The −3dB ARBW of 2.3 GHz (20.3-24.05 GHz) confirms the circular polarization attributes. Maximum isolation between the four radiating elements is less than −22dB and envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) less than 0.05 and the value of DG obtained between ports 1–2, 1-3& 1–4 value range of 9.999 - 10 dB, 9.979 – 9.999 dB & 9.90 - 9.99 dB respectively is observed. Four-port MIMO patch antenna has been investigated in terms of simulated gain, return loss, radiation efficiency, radiation pattern & total active reflection coefficient (TARC). The proposed antenna is analyzed using HFSS software by ANSYS version 17.

articleTitle: Low light Image Enhancement using DCE-Net aided by Pack and Unpack operations
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The main objective of Low Light Image enhancement is to process an image so that the result is more suitable for practical application. Images captured in dark circumstances have very low contrast, due to this people can't clearly identify the objects, which increases the difficulty of applied computer vision tasks considerably. Generally, this enhancement is done using image processing techniques like Histogram Equalization and its variants (CLAHE). But recent advances in deep learning enabled us to restore dark images which were hard to enhance with normal techniques. But often these techniques are limited by speed and hardware. This paper combines the DCE-net, Pack and UnPack algorithms to improve the performance of low light image enhancement, which aim to reduce the runtime.

articleTitle: An Adaptable and Extensible Code Smell Detection Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A Code Smell in computer programming is a surface sign that there may be an issue with respect to your framework and the nature of your code. This issue may require refactoring to be fixed. Code smell is an unpleasant usage decision in the plan stage. Code smells are markers of value issues that make a product difficult to keep up and develop. Given the significance of scents in the source code's viability, numerous examinations have investigated the attributes of scents and dissected their impacts on the product's quality. Code smells are attributes of programming thatdemonstrate issue in the code construction and framework plan that bring about the product is being hard to create and keep up. Large, code smells can be recognized through the code structure. The proposed framework approves code smell for foreseeing class change inclination to discover mistake in expectation of progress inclination utilizing code smell.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of gray code generator as test pattern generator
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Gray code is a process of encoding integers as a sequence of binary bits. These binary bits are arranged in such a way that two adjacent integers differ by a single binary digit. There are different types of grey code such as reflected binary, uniform balanced, antipodal, and so on. This paper mainly focuses on the reflected binary grey code. The reflected binary code is light weighted. The primary function of counters is to produce a specified output sequence and they are also called pattern generators. This paper contains the comparison of different bits of grey counters. The parameters of comparison are static power, dynamic power, utilization, and on-chip temperature.

articleTitle: High Performance VCO Design Using High Q SIW Resonator
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper presents a novel methodology to implement LC tank in the design of a Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO) for improved phase noise and tuning range. For frequency selection, Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) based LC resonator is proposed and employed in cross-coupled differential pair. The SIW is designed to operate in the range from 55 GHz to 70 GHz while the VCO is designed to work at 60 GHz using 65 nm CMOS technology. The SIW resonator based VCO achieves high Quality factor (Q), improved tuning range and phase noise compared to conventional LC tank VCO. Simulation and analysis of results are performed in Keysight Advanced Design Systems while SIW structure is designed in Ansys HFSS which forms the feedback path. A detailed comparison is made between the two methods. The conventional LC VCO has a measured tuning range of 7.5 GHz while consuming 2.38 mW power from a 1-V power supply where as SIW tank VCO has an improved 15 GHz tuning range, absorbing 0.385 mW power from a 1-V power supply. The LC VCO and SIW tank VCO has a phase noise of -143.585 dBc/Hz and -113.8 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz offset and corresponding figure of merits are - 164 dBc/Hz and -195 dBc/Hz respectively.

articleTitle: Grid Interfaced Single Stage Solar Water Pump Using SRM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The intent of the paper is to develop a grid interfaced single stage solar water pumping system using switched reluctance motor with PV control technique. Photovoltaic systems being environmental friendly energy sources are crucial due to their feasibility which have their own precedence, but there are some issues that need to be considered. Hence need to build maximum efficiency photovoltaic power generation is still probing situation. Attainable and foremost way to solve the drawback is to track sun automatically. Accomplishment of PV modules is based on solar radiation and atmospheric temperature, which affect voltage, current and power characteristics. So a Controller is essential to diminish impact and to utilize power from PV array optimally. Different control techniques are used for tracking and also at present frame work pumping water using solar panels has gained a lot of surveillance. Present topic using utility grid is employed with switched reluctance motor. SRM possess dominance over other motors. Grid connected systems are on hike owing to its integrity, accuracy and endurability. Since there is a substantial advancement of solar, uncomplicated control scheme and design through conducting research of PV energized switched reluctance motor for applications of pumping is initiated by MATLAB simulation.

Author Keywords: Water Pump Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT)
Bidirectional Power Flow and DC Link

articleTitle: RTL to GDSII implementation of Advanced High-Performance Bus Lite
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, it speaks about design of AHB-Lite and its implementation from RTL to GDSII. Cadence NC Launch tool is used for simulation. Input to NC Launch tool is Verilog file. Later gate level synthesis is carried out using cadence genus tool. Input to the cadence genus tool are i) verified Verilog file ii) .sdc file (synopsis design constraint file) iii) .lib file (library file).Output from cadence genus tool are gate level net list file and. sdc file (design constraint file). These both steps are of frontend part of design. And, in backend part of design cadence innovus tool is used. Reports for timing, area and power are calculated at all these steps of operations. At, last GDSII file is generated. All these process are carried out using 180nm technology cadence tool. Advanced High-performance-Lite bus operations like read and write will be designed, simulated and synthesized. Later, the physical implementation of Advanced High-performance-Lite will be implemented on Cadence Innovus tool. Optimization is carried out all steps of design in terms of power, timing and area. After doing post CTS, there will be more optimization. One have obtained optimized results for slack 2.019ps, power 62.6nW and area 442747.1664 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Indoor Self-Mapping Pill Dispensing Device Using SLAM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The elderly tend to forget the medications at times, and this has a colossal impact on their health. Especially for those who have been prescribed multiple medications at different dosages. Due to various added reasons such as decreased motor skills, inability to move around, they require constant attention and help with their medications. It is very crucial for them to take their pills as per the dose prescribed by the doctor. It becomes a tedious job for them and sometimes it can get very confusing. Hence the need for engaging a caretaker arises. Also given the COVID-19 Pandemic situation, the elderly are supposed to be isolated. Hence, this research work proposes a Pill Dispenser combined with a Self-Mapping robot to take appropriate medication. This research work utilizes SLAM based bot to map and navigate in an unknown environment. It makes use of the Robot Operating System (ROS) framework. The mapping process is done by using the GMapping algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Aided Diagnosis System for Neurocritical and Critical Diseases
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Emergency medical care is closely related to people's lives, is related to the well-being of the people, and can also reflect the level of health services in a region. The ability of good emergency medical services has become an important indicator to measure the capacity of social governance. In today's society, people's needs and requirements for emergency services are getting higher and higher, and emergency medical care is playing an increasingly important role in our daily lives. The emergency treatment process is mainly composed of three parts, namely the pre-hospital emergency process, the hospital emergency process and the intensive care treatment process (ICU). This article applies neural network computing and medical image processing technology to the emergency medical system.

articleTitle: LPG Leakage Detector with Smart SMS Alert using Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The LPG leakage detector with SMS alert using Microcontroller is a compactable device comprising of MQ-6 sensor that can be cast-off for sleuthing the leak of LPG gas anywhere near the sensor and it will make the buzzer sound on to give alert to the surroundings with increased probability to avoid major fire accidents and it will lead a SMS attentive to the person, so that the person will be able to know about the gas leakage in his/her house. It is not only used in domestic places, but it can also be cast-off in other places like in manufacturing industries where large amount manufacturing is happening with the help of LPG gas and it can be rummage-sale in industries to detect any gas leakage. The best adaption to prevent gas seepage accidents is to connect an LPG leakage indicator in a permeable place. The GSM module will be used to alert a person by SMS and a buzzer will be on simultaneously. It will show the SMS to the specified portable number using Microcontroller. If a gas exceeds normal level, then an immediate alarm is generated with the help of MQ-6 sensor, it is highly accurate and has high sensitivity towards LPG gas. It bids rapid response time and accurate detection.

articleTitle: An Intensive Study of Thermal Effects in High Speed Low Power CMOS Dynamic Comparators
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This research work intensively studied the impact of thermal effects on the logic performance of dynamic comparators implemented using 16 nm strained silicon/metal gate/high-K CMOS technology and with a power supply (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</inf>) of 0.7 V. The double tail latch type and pre-amplifier and latch type dynamic CMOS comparators exhibited a delay of 45.03 pS and 63.09 pS respectively. Moreover, the double tail latch type and pre-amplifier and latch type comparators consumed a power of 69.16 µW and 58.76 µW respectively. In order to investigate the thermal effects in dynamic CMOS comparators the operating temperature is varied from 30°C to 110°C and the pre-amplifier and regenerative latch type dynamic comparator is found to be exhibiting minimal noise compared with traditional double tail comparators. These two dynamic comparators implemented using 16 nm CMOS technology with a V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</inf>of 0.7 V are considered to be promising circuits for future ultra low power and high speed ADCs.

articleTitle: Farmer Connect”- A Step Towards Enabling Machine Learning based Agriculture 4.0 Efficiently
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This research work demonstrates the use cases of “Farmer Connect”- A Progressive Hybrid Application meant to ease out many primary low-level concerning issues in agriculture like a proper price margin for farmers, expanding the reach of traditional import-exports (from a region base system to a nation-wide system), reducing post-harvest crop wastage, connecting the buyer and the seller directly by eliminating the middlemen, forecasting prices of agriculture commodity accurately using Machine Learning, etc. This all small steps eventually helps in increasing the per capita income, brining changes in the agriculture sector and finally creating a roadmap to efficiently enable Agriculture 4.0. Currently, the networking is used on a heavy basis, whether it is LinkedIn for the tech guys or Social Media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Tinder for dating etc. through which the people are connected on a global scale, hence making new contacts which eventually directly affects in our business or other personal gains. But there's no such platform when it comes to the case of farmers or the Food Industries!! Then why not build a robust system which can connect the Farmer, the Dealer, Retailer and even large corporations together on a national or a global scale? This allows the farmer to find the right buyer at a competitive price across the nation and at the same time the dealer can buy good quality products through a single platform! Even the large corporations can get in touch with the farmers and buy products directly through them hence limiting the intermediaries which eventually is a win-win situation for both the farmer and the corporation. Combining all of this, this research work has developed a progressive hybrid application, which contains information about various farmers, dealers, retailers, corporations, transport service providers, cold storage facilities in lieu to connect all of them together. This directly results into situation where farmer no longer need to store their crops in cold storage or any other locations (or minimal use) as they can get buyers from across the nation. Hence, even reducing the major food wastage in logistics and cold chain section.

articleTitle: Binocular Stereo Vision Intelligent Control Framework for the Landing Position of Quadrotor UAV Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Binocular stereo vision intelligent control common framework for the landing position of quadrotor UAV based on fuzzy control is studied in this paper. The simulation system can truly reflect the changes in the position parameters of the UAV during the flight, and has the good user display and control interface. With the consideration of the vision model, the accuracy landing function is achieved. During autonomous landing, the drone always flies in the fixed altitude mode to maintain its own altitude stability. The altitude controller adopts the cascade PID control form of altitude with speed. Based on the experiment regarding the landing accuracy, it is reflected that the designed system can ensure the UAV intelligent control.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation of Image Processing based Vehicle Speed Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As road accidents grab more attention these days proposed implementation gives a solution to the problem by determining the speed of an automobile. Unlike conventional hardware-based methods such as radar guns, the proposed work comprises the automobile pace discernment based on image processing which is a real-time application. Each vehicle in the recorded video is identified, and a bounding box is created on the same. Centroid coordinates of the identified vehicle are marked to track its movement. On the other hand, the proposed implementation takes into account the techniques such as the Gaussian mixture model for foreground detection, clustering based on the density of pixel for clustering the foreground detection points, and Kalman filter for tracking the targeted automobile. The outturn of the project is a displayed video of the pace of the respective automobile between the bounded distances of ten meters in a low traffic area.

articleTitle: Study on Korean Language Teaching Evaluation Scheme Using Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: At present, Korean teaching in domestic colleges and universities can be said to be limited to the traditional teaching model of face-to-face teaching by teachers and students. This teaching mode is not only boring, it is difficult to improve students' interest in learning. Students are in a passive position of receiving knowledge, which is not conducive to the development of students' language application ability, and at the same time, it is difficult to realize information exchange and emotional exchange between teachers and students. If you want to master a language, you must first master certain vocabulary, so vocabulary teaching is the most basic content of language teaching in Korean. The advent of artificial intelligence technology has lowered the barriers for children to access quality education, and education has been democratized and liberalized, so everyone has an equal right to receive quality education. Using the AI-based education model, teachers can better grasp students' learning and correct them. Students can also communicate and evaluate each other's homework, so as to achieve the purpose of mutual learning and common progress.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Capacitance Cycle Ability with MnO2-Go Nanocomposite Supercapacitor
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this manuscript, the composite materials of MnO2-GO have elaborated the fabrication process of a supercapacitor. The nanocomposite materials of MnO2-GO are greatly deposited on the Stainless Steel (SS) substrate using the electrochemical deposition method. The composite of graphene oxide assisted by needle-like MnO2 nanocrystals (GOMnO2 nanocomposites) was fabricated using a simple soft chemical path. Intercalation and adsorption of manganese ions onto the GO sheets, followed by nucleation and growth of the crystal species. The potential of a supercapacitor to cycle and store energy was investigated using Galvano-static Charge Discharge and Cyclic- Voltammetry (CV). As a result, the composite MnO2-GO supercapacitor possesses better electrochemical capacitance. The chemical reaction between GO and MnO2 was found to improve the electrochemical efficiency of as-prepared nanocomposites. This process enables the deposit of MnO2 nanoparticles onto graphene oxide sheets (single layer of graphite oxide) in a simple and clear manner, and it can be easily applied to the preparation of other types of hybrids based on GO sheets for technical applications.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Enabled Intelligent Machine Learning based Diabetic Retinopathy Grading and Classification Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a commonly existing illness among diabetic patients and has become a major reason for blindness. The development of DR can be avoided by the earlier detection of the disease. The detection and severity estimation of DR can be made using retinal inspection. Besides, the machine learning (ML) models and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies help to detect and classify DR with enhanced performance and decreased cost. In this view, this paper presents an intelligent ML based DR grading and classification (IML-DRGC) model using retinal fundus images. The goal of the IML-DRGC model is to automatically diagnose the DR at maximum accuracy. The IML-DRGC model initially enables the IoT devices to capture the retinal fundus image of the patient. Then, the gathered image undergoes preprocessing using Gaussian filtering (GF) technique to get rid of the noise that exists in the fundus image. Followed by, fuzzy c-means enabled segmentation technique is exploited to detect the affected areas in the fundus image. Moreover, the Features from Accelerated Segment Test (FAST) model is utilized as a feature extractor. Finally, support vector machine (SVM) is used as a classification model to allot distinct labels of DR. For investigating the improved diagnostic outcome of the IML-DRGC model, a series of simulations were performed and the results are examined interms of different measures.

articleTitle: CNN based Tyre Life Prediction and Defect Identification System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The only part of the vehicle in contact with the road is the tyre. The tyre tread depth has a significant impact on the vehicle's braking ability and should be checked on a regular basis for driving protection. Slippage, a longer stopping time, and even flat tyres are all symptoms of worn tyres, which can lead to a car accident. If there is an automated inspection method that will allow the vehicle users to monitor their tyre life with their own hands instead of getting the vehicle to the garage spending time to diagnose it, resolving such types of the defect will boost the confidence while drive and saves significant money by extracting the maximum out of the tyres without compromising on safety. The prediction involves capturing the image of the thread section and sidewall of the tyre to be predicted. Then, the image will be processed to extract the thread and wall condition from an image for defect identification and to further improve the result and life predictions the vital information inputs are taken from the user through a mobile app. The proposed research work utilizes the CNN based prediction algorithm in order to leverage the best prediction result and recommendations to improve the tyre life.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of DTMOS based Operational Transconductance Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This proposed paper constitutes the circuit design, simulation and analysis of a proposed circuit of dynamic threshold-based OTA depicting enhanced performance in comparison to the simple OTA and OTA using DTMOS present in the literature. DTMOS technique fulfills the essential requirement of the less voltage and less power for the design of analog circuits. DTMOS technique portrays attractive applications of low noise and low power. The design and scrutiny are accomplished using 180 nm technology in the cadence tool.

articleTitle: Construction of Ideological Guiding Feedback System for Vocational Students Based on Mobile Intelligent Terminals and Stream Data
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Construction of ideological and political education teaching feedback system for vocational students based on mobile intelligent terminals and stream data is considered in this paper. The main function of data processing is to extract data that is of value to people from irregular data. The software part must cooperate with the hardware to realize a variety of functional operations, such as the data file management, data collection and processing, and human-computer interaction, etc. To this end, the novel mobile intelligent terminals and stream data analytic framework are then both designed to meet with the requirement. The feedback system is implemented for verification.

articleTitle: A Cost-effective IoT Based Fitness Tracker For Physically Challenged People
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: An artificial intelligence system is proposed for observing health with the aid of internet of things technology to make life easier for people with disabilities. It is capable of extracting a large amount of data (such as blood pressure, body temperature, humidity, electrocardiogram signals, and checking the level of gas and alcohol in the blood) from patients regularly and taking action (for example, displaying the data on a display or informing nearby or distant relatives about the patient's condition, IoT-based reporting system). To process all of the data obtained and visualize the results on the computer, an embedded device is used. The screen can be observed remotely via the internet using a camera.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Underground Soil Statistics Transmission Gadget Utilizing WUSN
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The wireless subterranean sensor network has many applications in various fields such as agriculture, health care, ecological monitoring, military, human rescue after natural disaster or intelligent agriculture. Basically, in WUSN, different types of underground transmission are possible, they are subterranean to aboveground, aboveground to subterranean communication [1]. In the agricultural field the small size transmitter and receiver antennas are placed at a certain depth under the soil and the data are transmitted from the dispatcher antenna to the collector antenna by using Electromagnetic waves (EM). While considering electromagnetic radiation, several factors should be taken into account to perform data transmission (i.e., reflection, refraction, diffraction) [2]. Here an advanced model is projected to overcome the issues in transmission of Electromagnetic Waves (EM) (i.e. Magnetic Induction waves (MI)). For both the Electromagnetic and Magnetic induction waves transmission there is no propagation medium required for the data to be transmitted. The small sized antennas are used at the dispatcher and the collector side designed using the magnetic induction coils. So, by using this advanced channel conditions of magnetic induction waves propagation there won't be any distraction while transmitting the data and the extent of conveyance will also be very high when compared to other types of communication paradigms.

articleTitle: A Study on LNA, PLL and BPF of Front-End Integrated RF Receiver for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: RF receiver or simply receiver is an electronic device or circuit which basically converts the received radio waves into a useful information. Radio receivers are broadly used in the areas of modern technology such as wireless modems, televisions. remote control, cell phones, wireless networking systems and other components of communications. The RF Receiver block contains a Low noise amplifier (LNA), Phase Locked Loops (PLL), and band pass filter (BPF). The main aim of this study is to provide a summary of the research, that has been conducted on design and implementation of RF receiver components. Although there are several ways to implement the RF receiver, this paper mainly concentrates on the implementation of the RF receiver using VLSI design methodology. Different parameters like technology, power dissipation, power gain, noise figure and return loss were considered in the review process. This review article serves the purpose of presenting results and techniques used in designing LNA, PLL and BPF in RF receiver for wireless applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent construction integrated management system based on BIM and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper studies the intelligent construction integrated management system based on BIM and Internet of Things. By seamlessly integrating the current Internet of Things technology and BIM technology to build a more intelligent and convenient construction integrated management system, it will further improve the application level of the comprehensive information in the construction management, operation and maintenance management of construction projects. The construction of this system is of great significance for further improving the modernization level and information level of the construction engineering field. Based on the above understanding, this article mainly from the perception layer, control layer and application layer + plus the Internet of things of intelligent building integrated management system, and discusses the system construction in the process of AI technology, big data and cloud processing technology of the embedded system, comprehensive treatment on modern information technology application advantages of the intelligent building integrated management system.

articleTitle: Fuzzy clustering algorithm modelling of data stream mining based on particle swarm optimization and GA
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Fuzzy clustering algorithm modelling of the data stream mining based on particle swarm optimization and GA is designed and implemented in this manuscript. In the intelligent optimization algorithm, the novel particle swarm optimization algorithm does not require any derivation of the solution function, and can overcome the complexity of the traditional optimization algorithm in the calculation and the disadvantages of the remaining optimization. In this regard, the GA model has been applied to enhance the training process of PSO. The data stream is selected as the experimental scenario to validate the model. The fuzzy model with the clustering analysis is combined for the optimal analysis. The robustness of the framework is tested.

articleTitle: Direct Torque Control for Five-Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Generator In wind energy conversion systems based on Slip Angle
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The concept of multiphase induction motor is been discussedin this paper with new proposed topology of direct angle control (DTC) method with the enhanced slip angle control method. In the normal DTC method the critical problems are due to the hysteresis control mechanism, includes variable switching frequency which depends on speed and larger torque ripple during dynamic changing load conditions. In this scenario a recently proposed control mechanisms analyzed to reduce the both torque ripple and the flux ripple by promising change with the switching frequency.

articleTitle: Identification of Facial Image Based Detection Using Image Transformation Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
