abstract: This paper describes how security is provided through the use of facial recognition. Discrete Cosine Transform is a technique used for identifying images based on the images that are already available in the database. Each image is split into parts, resulting in a spatial domain. It is then transformed to a frequency domain representation. The features present in each segment are extracted to obtain the detection of face based on the features extracted from the images present in database. Face recognition technique is extensively used for computing JPEG (joint photography expert group) image files and MPEG (moving photography expert group). Video files are familiar even to those who are not aware of the technology. When compared to DFT, the Discrete Cosine Transform is far more efficient.

articleTitle: Novel e-commerce platform based on artificial intelligence with data structure optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Novel e-commerce platform based on artificial intelligence with data structure optimization is designed in this study. To achieve the goal set, the analysis of the core systematic enhancement has been considered. Further, the proposed model separates and extracts the setting value of each parameter variable according to the application specification stored in the model description file. The functional layer is located in the middle of the platform architecture. It needs to use the access interface to complete the data exchange with the database, and use the message to exchange information with the user. The functional layer can use basic operation functions to complete data processing, and realize data storage, update and format conversion. Furthermore, the data structure optimization model is combined for the further implementation. The proposed model is validated through the test.

articleTitle: Aircraft Test Flight Assistant System Based on Sensor Network Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper devises a novel aircraft test flight assistance system by monitoring the sensor networks. In the flight test, the measuring rake uses a pitot tube to measure the total and static pressures. The total and static pressure sensors measure absolute pressures. When the internal flow rate of the inlet is small, the difference between the total and static pressures is very small, which will lead to some large flow measurement error. To overcome this challenge, this research work has designed a novel sensor network monitoring network system to perform the data collection work. The intelligent assessment model is then combined for performing further processing of features. Also, the proposed system is applied in the real-time applications.

articleTitle: High Speed Level Shifter Design for Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In modern world, there is a need for small and handheld devices like phones, tabs, and multimedia device etc., needs less power consumptions. As technology are growing, scaling of voltages is a major issue. In these cases, voltage level shifters can be used to give different voltages of circuit. In this paper, Level up Shifter with High Speed and Low Power has been presented. Current mirror based LS has average power 235.03pW, delay of 60.75ms and area of 8 transistor. LS based Inverter has average power 89.03pW, delay of 310.5ps and area of 4 transistor. Proposed LS has average power 70.05pW, delay of 285.06ps and area of 4 transistor. All the circuits were simulated using cadence virtuoso 180nmTechnology.

articleTitle: Effect of curve fitting in an automated cardiac arrhythmia detection system
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: An Automated offline Arrhythmia detection system is proposed with improved accuracy. The raw ECG signal obtained from the existing database is preprocessed using the FFT filter. In order to construct a smooth curve that will reproduce the HRV signal, the degree of the polynomial equation is determined by how many points are needed to match. A polynomial degree of n=7 equation is used which provides the best results in fitting the HRV signal. Wavelet and statistical parameters are combined as a single set of parameters called hybrid with curve fitting. The performance of the suggested algorithm is compared with other algorithms and tested on a MIT database. The accuracy of the proposed offline system is 93.75%.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Specific Absorption Rate of Microstrip and Monopole Patch Antenna on Human Forearm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The electromagnetic properties of the human bodies highly influence the performance characteristics of an antenna in a wireless body area network (WBAN). Specific absorption rate (SAR) is one of the most important criterions for the design of an antenna for WBAN. In this paper two types of antennas, the microstrip and monopole patch antennas are designed for the ISM band (2.4-2.5 GHz) application. Its performance characteristics are measured in free-space and in close proximity to the human body. In most of the cases, it becomes difficult to measure SAR due to lack of certified SAR measurement equipment, which are very costly. Hence, a simple and cost-effective SAR measurement method is also introduced to experimentally calculate SAR for different frequencies to check compliance with the safety guidelines. Finally, properties of both the antennas are compared in terms of SAR.

articleTitle: Vehicle Tracking using OCR and Triggering Home Automation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: When people step into their homes after a long, tiring day of work, they would wish to have a comforting environment around. This includes having an optimum temperature and proper lighting. This project develops a system to enable home automation upon the arrival of the resident. Vehicle detection is used to trigger the home automation system in order to indicate that the resident has arrived. In order to achieve this, the Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and machine learning concepts of LabVieware utilized. The characters of the vehicle's number plate have trained the model. If a vehicle is identified by the camera at the entrance, LabViewstarts detecting it and comparing it with the vehicle trained by us. If there is a match, the home automation procedure starts. The primary objective in our home automation system is to optimize the surrounding environment inside the house in accordance to the external temperature. This is achieved by using the myRIO device interfaced with LabVIEW. Theroom temperature has been detected by using temperature sensor, and using this data it will be cooled down to an optimum temperature.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Prototype Model for Monitoring of Automatic Platform with Train Arrival Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In the recent survey it was noticed that the most disadvantage and challenging thing in Indian railways is climbing up the overhead steps for the old and physically challenged people. Second thing is the collision of the overhead bridges due to the large number of crowd over it. To avoid overhead bridge some people will jump on to the track and runs towards the other platform, which is very risky. So, our main aim of this project is to create a temporary bridge between two platforms. The motivation to create this project is to avoid the overhead bridges for old and physically challenged people. Here we are using the new concept of movable temporary railway platform. For the successful operation of the system we use IR sensors, H-bridge, microcontroller and a speaker. IR sensors are used to sense the arrival and departure of the train. Microcontroller is used to operate the entire system. H-bridge is used to rotate the motor in forward and backward motion. Motor is used to rotate the temporary platform. After each and every movement of platform, it is updated and displayed through blynk application. And there will an announcement through speaker.

articleTitle: IoT Based Warning System from the Threat of Wild Animals
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Wildlife has recently become very common when it comes to inhabited areas. As humans encroach on trees, the habitat for wild animals is diminishing. When wild animals invade communities, it causes a great loss of property and lives. To build a warning system of potential animals exiting the park, this research work utilizes the newest developments in technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and the notification will also be sent to Smartphone users to alert them. To do this, the low cost motion detectors and Passive Infrared sensors are used. In order to take more measures, the proposed system relay on the information about certain movements of a control room. Also, this research work involves in the creation of noisy noise by speakers in which animals are unable to reach the land. IoT's fundamental concept is to link numerous sensors and to create connectivity and to provide services as well. In this post, to build an alarm system, multiple IoT devices are utilized at the periphery of the natural reserve. This device can also be used to identify smugglers and other individuals entering the forest illegally.

articleTitle: Design of Multimedia Guiding System based on Compressed Sensing of Streaming Signal to Assist Vocal Music Guiding
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Vocal music singing is an artistic carrier that integrates language and melody. In the process of singing, there are relatively stable technical procedures and active inner activities. Therefore, in the process of vocal music education and teaching, if only pay attention to the external muscle training and ignore the inner skill acquisition rules, it is impossible to achieve satisfactory singing state and effective learning effect. It is very important to understand the singer's psychological factors and cultivate good psychological quality in vocal music classroom teaching. Mr. Zou Changhai, China's famous vocal music educator, also said: “Singing is physiology, but also physics, but in the final analysis is psychology.” This proves that in the classroom teaching, the analysis and research of singing psychological problems is conducive to let us more clearly understand the importance of psychological factors in vocal music teaching.

articleTitle: The Novel Improved Hybrid Clustering Algorithm of Particle Swarm and K-Means Considering Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The novel improved hybrid clustering algorithm of the particle swarm and K-Means considering applications is well studied in this paper. This research work considers each object present in the space as a particle with a certain mass, and there is a spherical symmetrical virtual data field around it. The output result of the system in this paper is closer to the true target value. The reason is that the analysis system set in this paper applies the clustering objective function, which makes up for the shortcomings of traditional systems that are easy to fall into local extreme values, slow clustering speed and poor analysis accuracy. The K-means is optimized with the particle swarm considering the data structure. The proposed method is simulated on different database.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Science and Engineering Technology in College Computer Online Education
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In today's society, the popularization rate of computers in the whole country and even all over the world is increasing rapidly year by year. This makes People's Daily work closely connected with computers, information technology and the Internet. As an auxiliary tool, the computer provides great convenience for the process of teaching. Intelligent tools make the learning process more convenient, so the significance of computer science and technology to computer education is huge. In the teaching process, teachers should try their best to use the advantages of computers to assist teaching, and provide students with better network learning environment and learning conditions. Different from the traditional teaching methods, the application of computer technology to education has gradually formed a new type of computer education. This has caused a great change to the current situation of China's education development, and at the same time, China's education model is also faced with various problems.

articleTitle: Novel Uncontrolled 20-Pulse AC-DC Converters to Reduce Harmonics of the Excitation Current
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Power electronic devices are prone to harmonics as they are non-linear solid state devices. In this research work, two novel 20-pulse passive AC-DC converters are proposed to limit total harmonic distortion (THD) content of the excitation or input AC current. Value of the input current THDs found are 6.52% and 6.57% for series connected and parallelly connected rectifiers respectively. As both of the designed converters are passive in nature so they doesn't need any type of extra gate pulse producing circuit. Thus this is a cost effective approach to limit the harmonics. Designed series connected rectifier have high voltage (≥ 1kV) applications where proposed parallel connected rectifier can be used where there is a demand of high current (≥ 100A). Moreover modified version of the proposed series connected 20-pulse converter can be used for HVDC generation. This paper also explains the working principle of the proposed rectifiers with proper figures.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Tourism Etiquette Training Framework based on Attitude Detection System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Tourism industry is an open and extremely external industry. When carrying out tourism work, it is highly required to frequently communicate with people from different walks of life. At this time, the importance of etiquette is highlighted. Staff in the communication, the performance of the etiquette norms, visitors from all over the country can have a communication role. In this paper, the advantages of these technologies are complemented by multi-mode information fusion, and a series of targeted design optimization are carried out combined with the use scene of flexible exoskeleton, and a complete set of flexible exoskeleton posture detection process is proposed.

articleTitle: IOT Based Surveillance and Health Monitoring System for Elderly and Physically Challenged People
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: IOT is a system in which objects are connected through internet where data is collected and transferred over wireless network. Wifi acts as a communication protocol with which various home automation techniques can be implemented. This can be done using ZigBee, Bluetooth etc. These existing techniques have certain drawbacks such as they work in short range so this paper aims at using IOT technology which helps in providing both Health monitoring and Smart security system. We are going to implement by using Node MCU Module. This also aims at being more helpful for aged people and physically challenged.

articleTitle: Designing of 32-Bit Configurable Hack CPU On FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper discusses the previous research on various 16-bit, 32-bit RISC processors with its architecture and high-speed with minimal energy consumption. This study found that the pipeline has five stages and number of instructions has been created for such processors. This study may act as a benchmark to use particular method as per one's available resource. Also, after proper analysis of each of these methods, the scope for further development will increase that helps to create a space for new research.

articleTitle: Meta Learning Gradient Boosted Neural Network Model Based Diabetes Risk Prediction with Bias Reduction Using OCT Image Attributes
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Ensemble learning is defined as technique used to combine feeble techniques to develop a robust technique to maximize the algorithm efficiency. Ensemble boosting technique is combined with neural network to improve the prediction accuracy. The combined technique is optimized with fine-tuned hyper parameters, and it is cross validated to avoid overfitting. Neural network is defined as the technique used to imitate human memory that consists of number of perceptrons to accept input data from user. Input layer consists of number of input nodes based on input data given by user. The weight calculation and parameter calculation are performed in hidden layer. The output layer consists of output nodes to display the required output. This work consists of OCT retinal parameters of Myopic, CSR and normal data of to predict diabetic risk. This work discusses about optimized and cross validated gradient boosted neural network with 98% prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning Neural Network for Medical Internet of Things Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The Internet of Things technology in medical applications ensures that the medical industry can improve the quality and optimization of medical care. In a medical image, the parameters of the imaging device can be identified and then the medical image is analyzed, and corrective actions can be taken in real time. Digitization has reached many areas of medical technology. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is technology development in the medical field that MRI Images can be brain tumor classified as a disease of a patient's internal organs, and then generate high-resolution images for detection. A condition can be identified as a brain tumor by reading the MRI image. MRI technology is useful for detecting brain tumor diseases with drugs. The weakness of detecting brain tumor diseases performed by doctors on MRI images is still manual. The proposed Deep Leamer's Neural Network algorithms are important methods in medical imaging using MRI images for predicting the early symptoms of a disease medical imaging MRI methods. Medical image in human brain tumor position, different functions based on the tumor image are obtained, including contrast, energy, dissimilarity, uniformity, entropy and correlation. The simulation results show that the proposed Deep Learning Neural Network (DLNN) algorithm achieves better detection of abnormal. It is in low grayscale exfoliation and normal tissues in the human brain. The proposed DLNN algorithm also detects human brain tumors within seconds in a short time compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Big Data Technology Assists the Application of Proportional Liability: From Data Understanding Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This research study analyzes the big data technology that assists the application of proportional liability from the data understanding perspective. 3D model segmentation is the fine-grained 3D recognition task. Given a 3D model, each point or surface of the point cloud model or grid model is assigned a partial category label. To overcome the challenges of the traditional approaches, the data understanding model is optimized to fit for the novel scenarios. The data structure is optimized and the fuzzy analysis pattern is revised. Furthermore, the proposed model is applied into the analysis of the proportional liability scenario. Also, a test has been conducted on the public database. The experimental results prove the comprehensive performance.

articleTitle: IoT (LoRa WAN) Architecture Design for Meteorological data System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Now a day's farmers are facing so many problems related to crop harvesting. They do not get Proper communication related to weather and climate information. These cause significant losses in production and economy and their lives. To address these issues, a better communication antenna design should be developed. The LORA WAN technology is designed to overcome the above problems and will give the considerable growth in terms of crop productiveness. This antenna is used to transmit the meteorological information to long-rages. The data collection, monitoring and controlling is very difficult for disaster and relief management applications [3], [4]. In many applications like Environment sustainability and agriculture fields, The Wireless Sensor Networks are utilized to gather the data and analyze their physical characteristics, readings and transmit that information for remote areas [11]–[14].

articleTitle: E-Library Implementation Using Android Studio
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this digital era, anything can be obtained over the internet, so people don't have to deal with any inconveniences or waste most of our time. E-Library implementation using android studio is an application where all the e-textbooks will be available to the students handy. It is an android application; it makes the students easy to view the textbooks they need. Students need not go in search for books to the library or other websites. Sometimes there may be lack of books too in the library. Using this application, the student or the user should have to first login then choose their branch, and then choose the year of their course, then choose the semester and then all the subjects related to that semester will be displayed and the subject can be then selected. Once you choose the subject the e-textbook will be displayed either in pdf format or you will be redirected to the website. If the students need any other textbooks they can mention it in the feedback block. The admin can then view the reviews/feedback given by the user and upload the e-textbooks accordingly.
